Nɔ ko yɛ hiɔwe gblee kaa ja Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ, nɔ nɛ je hiɔwe kple si kɛ ba a.”
Nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da, se a be he wami nɛ a kɛ ma fa a he ɔ, nyɛ bu mɛ fɔ, nɛ nyɛ gbe mɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a poo osɛkɛ ɔmɛ ngɔ wo wo ɔ mi, nɛ a pɛne kpa nɛ fi kudɔɔ ɔ hulɔ. Jehanɛ a wo abalaa nɛ ngɛ lɛ ɔ yi ɔ, konɛ kɔɔhiɔ ɔ nɛ ha nɛ lɛ ɔ nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ ya hɛ mi. Kɛkɛ nɛ wa ngɔ wa yi kɛ pi wo kpo ɔ.
Se munyu nɛ kudɔɔtsɛ ɔ, kɛ lɛtsɛ ɔ tu ɔ mohu ya asafoatsɛ ɔ yi mi pe ga nɛ Paulo wo mɛ ɔ.
Niinɛ, sane kpakpa a nɛ i fiɛɛ ɔ, lɔ ɔ kɛkɛ ha we mi he blɔ kaa ma fĩa, ejakaa Mawu nitsɛ nɛ fa mi ke ma pee jã. Kaa i fiɛ we sane kpakpa a, jinɛ musu tloo mi pɛ!
Maria ya su he nɛ Yesu ngɛ ɔ, nɛ amlɔ nɔuu nɛ e na Yesu ɔ, e kpla si ngɛ Yesu nane nya, nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, kaa o ngɛ hiɛ ɔ jinɛ ye nyɛminyumu ɔ ko gbo we.”
Se ke a kpale kɛ ba Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ngɔ kɛkɛ a ma je hɛ mi hami nɔ́ ɔ ha mɛ.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ngɛ hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ ngɛ Kristo mi ɔ, peeɔ e he klɔuklɔu kaa bɔ nɛ Kristo hu ngɛ klɔuklɔu ɔ.
Yuda bi jio, ma je li jio, Kristo nɔ lɛ wɔ tsuo wa maa gu kɛ ba Tsɛ ɔ ngɔ. Mumi Klɔuklɔu kake ɔ nɔuu lɛ maa piɛ wa he.
Jokuɛ ɔ ba wa ngɛ nɔmlɔ tso mi; e le ní hulɔ, nɛ Mawu gbaa lɛ babauu.
Jehanɛ ɔ, e de tsɔli ɔmɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ yɛ eko ya ha nɔ nɛ ngɛ ní tsumi ɔ nɔ hyɛe ɔ.” A yɛ nyu
Jehanɛ ɔ, e plɛ e he, nɛ e na Yesu nɛ daa si, se e yo we lɛ.
Nyɛɛ hi ye mi nɛ imi hu ma hi nyɛ mi. Kaa bɔ nɛ tso kɔni be nyɛe maa wo yiblii ngɛ lɛ nitsɛ e dɛ he, se ja e mɛtɛ wai tso ɔ he ɔ, jã kɛ̃ nyɛ hu ke nyɛ hi ye mi ɔ, nyɛ be yiblii woe.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, benɛ Samaria bi ɔmɛ ba Yesu ngɔ ɔ, a kpa lɛ pɛɛ ke e hi a ngɔ. Nɛ Yesu kɛ mɛ hi lejɛ ɔ ligbi enyɔ.
Nyɔmtsɛ kake, hemi kɛ yemi kake, kɛ nɔ sɔlemi kake lɛ ngɛ.

Ejakaa yakayaka si himi nɛ nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ si ha nyɛ ɔ, nyɛ le hĩɔ nɛ Mawu wo loko e kɛ kpɔ nyɛ kɛ je mi nɛ nyɛ ye nyɛ he. Pi nɔ́ ko nɛ puɛɔ kaa sika hiɔ, loo sika tsu nɛ Mawu ngɔ kɛ tsu kikɛmɛ a ní nɛ ɔ,
Yesu de mɛ ke, “Abraham nina ji nyɛ jinɛ nyɛ maa pee níhi nɛ Abraham pee ɔ nɔuu.
Jehanɛ a kɛ lakpa odase yeli komɛ ba, nɛ a ba de ke, “Daa nɛ ɔ, kikɛmɛ a nɔmlɔ nɛ ɔ tuɔ munyu kɛ siɔ wa sɔlemi we klɔuklɔu ɔ, kɛ Mose mlaa a.
“Koo pɛtɛ he, koo sa o nya, nɛ koo ta he tete po” ɔ?
Se Paulo kple si, nɛ e ya bu e nɔ, nɛ e fua lɛ. E de ni ɔmɛ ke, “Nyɛ ko jé ngmlaa; wami ngɛ e mi kɛ mwɔɔ!”
Yoo, i le bɔ nɛ ma pee, kɛkɛ ɔ, ke ye ní tsumi ɔ je ye dɛ ɔ, ma na huɛmɛ nɛ ma he mi atuu kɛ to we.’
Yesu de lɛ ekohu ke, “Ke o de ke o be huno ɔ, o tu anɔkuale.
Nyɛ ko sisi nyɛ he kaa nyɛ maa bu munyu ɔ tue kɛkɛ; mohu nyɛɛ pee munyu ɔ nɔ yeli.
Yuda bi ɔmɛ nu kikɛmɛ a nyumu nɛ ɔ, nɛ jinɛ a
Ngɛ mlaa a blɔ fa mi ɔ, i plɛ pee nɔ gbogboe, konɛ ma hi wami mi ha Mawu mohu. I kɛ Kristo a sɛu ɔ nɛ.
Se kɛ̃ ɔ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ munyu ɔ ko gbɛ fĩa fuu ko hu ngɛ ma a mi he je ɔ, nyɛ ha waa bɔ mɛ kɔkɔ ke a ko ngɔ Yesu biɛ kɛ tsɔɔ ní hu.”
Wa nu nɛ e de ke, Yesu, Nazaret no ɔ, maa ku sɔlemi we nɛ ɔ, nɛ e ma tsake blɔ nyahi nɛ Mose ngɔ ha wɔ ɔ.”
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, awenyɛ nɛ i suɔ! I kpa mo pɛɛ, nyɛ ha nɛ waa suɔ wa sibi. Nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ ngmae nɛ ɔ, pi mlaa he, se mohu mlaa a nɛ a wo wɔ kɛ je sisije ɔ.
Pi kaa anɔkuale ɔ nɛ nyɛ li nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ womi nɛ ɔ ngmae. Dɛbi! Akɛnɛ nyɛ le anɔkuale ɔ, lɔ ɔ he mohu nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ womi ɔ ngmae ɔ nɛ; nɛ nyɛ le hu kaa anɔkuale ɔ, lakpa be mi.
Ni ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ nyɛ hɛ mi hae ɔ, nyɛ bu kaa a suɔ nyɛ; a be nyɛ he juɛmi kpakpa. A ngɛ hlae nɛ a puɛ i kɛ nyɛ wa kpɛti, konɛ nyɛ gbo mɛ mohu a he dengme.
Nyɛ ma de ekohu ke, ‘Waa kɛ mo lɛ ye ní, nɛ waa kɛ mo lɛ nu ní; o tsɔɔ ní ngɛ wa magbɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ.’
Kristo he ɔ, wa plɛ kuasiahi, se nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ ba pee ní leli! Wa gbɔjɔ, se nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ he mi ba wa nyɛ! Nyɛ hɛ mi ba nyami, se wɔɔ lɛɛ wa hɛ mi pue si.
ejakaa Mawu Ope ɔ pee ní nguanguahi ha mi.
Se bɔ nɛ ba nɛ e ngɛ nɔ hyɛe amlɔ nɛ ɔ, lɔ ɔ lɛɛ wa li; nɛ nɔmlɔ nɛ ha nɛ e bɔni nɔ́ hyɛmi ɔ hu wa li lɛ. Nyɛ bi lɛ; e wa nɛ lɛ nitsɛ e ma nyɛ je munyu nya.”
A pee ja niinɛ, nɛ a ngɔ sika a kɛ mane asafo nikɔtɔma amɛ kɛ gu Barnaba kɛ Saulo a nine nɔ.
Ejakaa ngmami ɔ deɔ ke, “Osɔfo ji mo kɛ yaa neneene kaa Melkizedek pɛ.”
Yi nikɔtɔma amɛ ɔ, o kɛ mɛ nɛ hi si kaa mo nitsɛ o nyɛmɛ, nɛ o kɛ yihewi ɔmɛ nɛ hi si kaa o nyɛmiyihi; se hyɛ nɛ yakayaka fiɛmi kó ba je mi.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a ya to Yesu gbogboe ɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, ejakaa yɔkɔ ɔ he kɛ we, nɛ jehanɛ ɔ hu, jamɛ a ligbi ɔ nɛ a dlaa he kɛ haa Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ nɛ.
Se a ti ni komɛ pue nɔ kɛ ho nɛ a ya sɛɛ níhi nɛ Yesu pee ɔ ha Farisi bi ɔmɛ.
Yuda bi komɛ nɛ yee Mawu gbeye ngɛ Yerusalem jamɛ a be ɔ mi. A je je ma amɛ tsuo a mi.
Anɛ nyɛ li kaa yayami peeli be blɔ nya ko ngɛ Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ mi lo? Nyɛ ko sisi nyɛ he! Yaholi, loo amaga jali, loo gba puɛli, loo nyumuhi kɛ yihi sɔuu nɛ kɛ a sibi peeɔ yakayaka ní,
Benɛ bɔfo ɔmɛ si to hyɛli ɔmɛ, nɛ a kpale kɛ ho hiɔwe ya a, to hyɛli ɔmɛ de a he ke, “Nyɛ ha nɛ waa ya Betlehem, nɛ wa ya hyɛ nɔ́ nɛ ba, nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ je tsɔɔ wɔ nɛ ɔ.”
Tsɛ te nɛ ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti, nɛ ke e bi bi lɛ abolo nɛ e ma ha lɛ tɛ? Aloo ke e bi lɛ lo, nɛ e maa ngɔ sinɔ ngɔ pee lo ngɔ ha lɛ?
Se Natanael bi Filipo ke, “Anɛ nɔ́ kpakpa ko maa je Nazaret lo?”
Nɔ nɛ heɔ Bi ɔ yeɔ ɔ, e nine su neneene wami ɔ nɔ; se nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ bui Bi ɔ tue ɔ, e be neneene wami nae. Mawu maa gbla e tue mohu.
Pohu ngmami ɔ nɛ de ke e sa nɛ e te si kɛ je gbeje ɔ, a nui sisi kɛ mwɔɔ.
Ma ya nɔ ma fĩa kɛ̃, pohu se nami ko be he. Jehanɛ lɛɛ nɔ́ nɛ he munyu nɛ ma tu ji bɔ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo je e he kpo tsɔɔ mi, kɛ e suɔmi nya níhi nɛ e tsɔɔ ke ma pee.
Nyɛɛ ngɔ nyɛ he ngɔ mɛtɛ lɛ, nɛ nyɛɛ ngɔ nyɛ he kɛ ha lɛ kulaa. Nyɛ ha nɛ nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ mi nɛ wa kaa bɔ nɛ a tsɔɔ nyɛ ɔ, nɛ nyɛɛ na Mawu si daa.
Kikɛ nɛ ɔ nyɛ be yi! Nɛ nyɛ ngɔ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ kɛ je sisi ɔ, jehanɛ lɛɛ nyɛɛ kɛ he lo maa gbe nya.
E ko pee nɔ ko nɛ tsake e tsui kɛ we. Ke pi ja a, e ma wo e he nɔ, nɛ Mawu maa gbla e tue kaa bɔ nɛ e pee Abosiami ɔ.
Yesu he nɔ ke, “I tuɔ munyu paa kɛ haa nɔ tsuaa nɔ. Daa nɛ ɔ, i tsɔɔ ní ngɛ kpe he ɔmɛ, kɛ sɔlemi we ɔ he nɛ Yuda bi kulaa kpee ngɛ ɔ, nɛ i de we nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko ngɛ laami mi gblee.
Kikɛmɛ a okadi nɛ ɔ nɛ e to mɛ ɔ he nɛ ma kpekpemi ɔ ya kpee lɛ ɔ nɛ.
Nɔ ko hu be dee ke, ‘O nɛ, e ngɛ hiɛ ɔ;’ aloo, ‘E ngɛ lejɛ ɔ’; ejakaa Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ, nyɛ mi lɛ e ngɛ.”
Jehanɛ ɔ, osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa a nyɔguɛ ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake, nɔ nɛ Petro po e tue ɔ weku no bi Petro ke, “Anɛ i nɛ o kɛ lɛ ngɛ abɔɔ ɔ mi lo?”
Benɛ ni ɔmɛ nu munyu nɛ ɔ, e hao mɛ wawɛɛ, nɛ a bi Petro kɛ bɔfo kpa amɛ nɛ piɛ e he ɔ ke, “Wa nyɛmimɛ, kɛ wa maa pee kɛɛ?”
Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, Kaisare Augusto fa ke a kane nihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ Roma nɔ yemi he ɔ, nɛ a ngma a biɛ.
Se imi lɛɛ i na kaa e pee we nɔ́ ko nɛ sa gbenɔ. Akɛnɛ lɛ nitsɛ e ngɔ e sane ɔ kɛ ha Roma matsɛ ɔ he je ɔ, i ma nya si kaa a ngɔ lɛ kɛ ya ha Roma matsɛ ɔ.
Nyɛɛ hyɛ mɔmɔhi nɛ ngɛ puɛe ha; a tsu we ní, nɛ a kpɛ we tade hulɔ. Se i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, Matsɛ Salomo kɛ e ní babauu ɔ, lɛ tete po e be miaa we kaa mɔmɔ nɛ ɔmɛ a kpɛti kake.
Jehanɛ, nyɛ nyumu kuyo ɔmɛ, kɛ yalɔyi ɔmɛ ɔ, i ngɛ dee ke e maa hi ha nyɛ ke nyɛ maa ya nɔ maa hi si kikɛ nɛ ɔ kaa bɔ nɛ imi hu i ngɛ ɔ.
Osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa a bi Stefano ke, “Anɛ munyu nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ mi ja lo?”
Nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ tsɔ kɛ ya Yohane ngɔ, nɛ e ye anɔkuale ɔ he odase.

Benɛ i kɛ nyɛ ngɛ, nɛ e fi mi tete ɔ, i hɛwi nyɛ ti nɔ ko nɔ ko; nyɛmimɛ nɛ je Makedonia kɛ ba a ba ha mi nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ hia mi. I pee we tlomi ngɛ nyɛ kuɛ nɔ. Nɛ kɛ je mwɔnɛ ɔ kɛ yaa a hu i hyɛ we nyɛ yemi kɛ buami ko blɔ.
Ejakaa Mumi ɔ bɛ a ti nɔ ko nɔ lolo; se a sɔle mɛ ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu biɛ mi kɛkɛ.
Mose nɛ ɔ nɛ e kɛ Israel ma kpekpemi ɔ nɛ ji wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ hi nga a nɔ ɔ nɛ. Lɛ nɛ e kɛ Mawu bɔfo ɔ tu munyu ngɛ Sinai yo ɔ he; nɛ lɛ nɔuu nɛ e ngɔ Mawu sɛ gbi nɛ wami ngɛ mi ɔ ba ha wɔ.
Hejɔɔmi ligbi nɛ nyɛɛ se ɔ, ma a tsuo tu kɛ ba, nɛ a ba bu Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ munyu ɔ tue.
Dloomi, mɔbɔ nami, kɛ he jɔmi nɛ je Tsɛ Mawu ɔ, kɛ Tsɛ ɔ Bi Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo dɛ mi ɔ kɛ wɔ nɛ hi si ngɛ anɔkuale kɛ suɔmi mi.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ hyɛ lɛ nitsɛ e ní peepee. Ke e hi ɔ, e ma nyɛ maa fĩa ngɔ fɔ nɔ, nɛ e be hiae kaa e maa ngɔ e he ngɔ to nɔ kpa he;
Se nihi tsuo nɛ he lɛ atuu, nɛ a he lɛ ye ɔ, e ha mɛ blɔ nya kaa a ba pee Mawu bimɛ.
Amlɔ ɔ nɔuu ɔ, e bɔni nɔ́ hyɛmi, nɛ e nyɛɛ Yesu se, nɛ e ngɛ Mawu yi jee. Benɛ nimli kpekpemi ɔ na nɔ́ nɛ ba a, mɛ tsuo a je Mawu yi.
Se Paulo de asafoatsɛ ɔ, kɛ ta buli ɔmɛ ke, “Ke lɛ mi ní tsuli ɔmɛ je lɛ ɔ mi lɛɛ nyɛ be je mi tlɔe.”
Timoteo, hyɛ mo nitsɛ o he nɔ saminya; nɔ́ nɛ o ngɛ tsɔɔe ɔ hu hyɛ nɔ bɔ nɛ sa. Ejakaa ke o pee ja a, o ma he mo nitsɛ o yi wami, kɛ nihi nɛ buɔ mo tue ɔ hulɔ.
Wa mlaa a nya a, Mose fa ke, ‘Yo kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ, a fia lɛ tɛ nɛ e gbo.’ Moo lɛɛ kɛ o ngɛ dee kɛɛ?”
E fɔɔ si paa kaa nɔ nɛ nɔ kuɔ lɛ gbaa nɔ nɛ ngɛ e sisi.
Yuda bi ɔmɛ nɛ ba Maria ngɔ ɔ, a ti nihi babauu na nɔ nɛ Yesu pee ɔ, nɛ a he lɛ ye.
Se ke wa he nile buɔ wɔ fɔ ɔ, wa le kaa Mawu kle pe wa he nile ɔ, nɛ e le nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ hulɔ.
Paulo hla kaa e kɛ Timoteo nɛ ya; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e po lɛ. E pee ja ejakaa Yuda bi tsuo nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ kpokpa a nɔ ɔ le kaa Timoteo tsɛ ɔ Hela no ji lɛ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Yesu ba kɛ̃ abolo ɔ, nɛ e ngɔ ha mɛ. Nɛ e ha mɛ lo ɔ hulɔ.
Mlaa tsɔɔli ɔmɛ, kɛ Farisi bi ɔmɛ ngɔ yo ko nɛ ya ngɛ ajuama bɔe nɛ a nu lɛ kɛ ba, nɛ a kɛ lɛ ba da ma a tsuo hɛ mi.
Se kɛ̃ ɔ, i kpa nyɛ pɛɛ, nyɛ na tsui! Nyɛ ti nɔ ko nɔ ko be gboe. Lɛ ɔ kɛkɛ nɛ ma bɔ wɔ.
Ma mi bi ɔmɛ a ti nihi babauu he Yesu ye, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a bi ke, “Anɛ Mesia a nɛ maa ba a ma nyɛ to okadi pe nɔmlɔ nɛ ɔ lo?”
Yuda bi ɔmɛ bi Yesu ke, “Ke wa de ke Samaria no ji mo, nɛ mumi yayami ngɛ o mi ɔ, wa tɔ lo?”
Mɛni he je nɛ o ngɛ tsle toe? Tee si nɛ o ha a sɔle mo ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ biɛ mi, nɛ o kpa Mawu pɛɛ nɛ e ngɔ o he yayami kɛ pa mo.’
Kuasiahi! Mawu nɛ pee kpo nɔ je ɔ, pi lɛ nɔuu nɛ pee mi mi je ɔ hulɔ ɔ?
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, moo tsɔ nihi kɛ ya Yopa, nɛ o ya kpee Simon nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Petro hulɔ ɔ kɛ ba.
Mawu ngɔɛ blema bi ɔmɛ a he ngɔ ki mɛ, se mohu e ngɔ nyu kpekpemi kɛ kpata yayami peeli ɔmɛ a hɛ mi. Noa nɛ fiɛ ke a ye dami sane ɔ, e kɛ ni kpaago kpa komɛ pɛ lɛ Mawu he a yi wami.
To kɛ na muɔ, kɛ na bi nɛ a sã a la zu ji níhi nɛ a kɛ fĩaa nihi nɛ ble a he ɔ a nɔ, nɛ a kɛ tsuɔ a nɔmlɔ tso ɔ he ngɛ he lo blɔ fa mi.
Kaseli ɔmɛ de ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, hyɛ! Klaate enyɔ ngɛ hiɛ ɔ!”
lɛɛ be nɛ ɔ mi nɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ ngɛ ní tsue ɔ, anɛ Mawu hɛ mi nyami ɔ be kpɛe kulaa pe kekle ɔ lo?
Benɛ Farisi bi ɔmɛ nu nɛ ma kpekpemi ɔ ngɛ Yesu he munyu tue kusikusi ɔ, a kɛ osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ tsɔ nihi ke a ya nu lɛ kɛ ba.
Nyɛ hlaa ngmami ɔmɛ a mi, ejakaa nyɛ susuɔ kaa a mi nyɛ ma na neneene wami ngɛ; nɛ lɔ ɔmɛ nɔuu yeɔ ye he odase.
ejakaa lɛ nitsɛ e ye odase ke, “A bui gbalɔ ngɛ lɛ nitsɛ e ma mi.”
Wa nɛ̃ Yakob nɛ ha wɔ kikɛmɛ a vu nɛ ɔ; nɛ lɛ nitsɛ, kɛ e bimɛ, kɛ e lohwehi tsuo nu e mi nyu. Anɛ o ngɛ hlae nɛ o tsɔɔ kaa moo o pe Yakob ɔ lo?”
Yesu he nɔ ke, “Tse i de nyɛ momo nɛ nyɛ he we yi! Tsaatsɛ he wami nya nɛ i tsuɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ níhi nɛ i tsuɔ ɔ yeɔ ye he odase.
Benɛ a kpale ya lejɛ ɔ si enyɔne ɔ, Yosef je e he si ngɔ ha e nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ Egipt matsɛ ɔ hu ba le Yosef weku ɔ.
kɛ ya su ligbi nɛ a ngɔ lɛ kɛ ho hiɔwe ya. Loko a ngɔ lɛ kɛ ho hiɔwe ya a, e gu Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ nɔ nɛ e tsɔɔ bɔfohi nɛ e hla a mlaa nɛ a ye nɔ.
se nɔ nɛ maa nu nyu nɛ imi ma ha lɛ ɔ, kuma be lɛ yee hu gblegbleegble. Ejakaa nyu nɛ ma ha lɛ ɔ ma plɛ nyu hɛngmɛ nɛ baa nyu nɛ haa nɔ wami kɛ yaa neneene ngɛ e mi.”
Bi nɛ e kɛ yo nyɔguɛ ɔ fɔ ɔ, a fɔ lɛ kɛkɛ; se bi nɛ yo odehe ɔ fɔ ɔ, Mawu wo e he si.
Se ke Mawu dɛ mi nɛ e je ɔ, nyɛ be Mawu nɔ nyɛe maa ye. Nyɛ ko ba pee nyɛ he kaa nihi nɛ a kɛ Mawu ngɛ ta hwue!”
Enɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a se ɔ, nyɛ ha suɔmi nɛ pee kaa tade nɛ nyɛ wo, ejakaa suɔmi ngɛ kaa kpa nɛ fiɔ níhi tsuo ngɔ peeɔ kake, nɛ lɛ tsuo peeɔ pɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, gbi slɔɔtohi a tumi ji okadi kɛ ha nihi nɛ he we yi, pi ni nɛmɛ nɛ heɔ yeɔ. Sane kpakpa a fiɛmi lɛɛ nihi nɛ heɔ yeɔ ɔ a we okadi ji lɔ ɔ nɛ, pi ni nɛmɛ nɛ he we yi.
Daa nɛ i kɛ nyɛ ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ lɛɛ nyɛ de we ke nyɛ maa nu mi. Se nyɛ ngmlɛfia a ji nɛ ɔ nɛ; diblii matsɛ ɔ ní tsumi be su!”
Se nyɛmimɛ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ suɔ, e hia kaa waa na Mawu si daa ha nyɛ. Ejakaa kɛ je sisije lokoo ɔ, Mawu hla nyɛ, nɛ e he nyɛ yi wami kɛ gu mumi ɔ nɛ maa tsu nyɛ he ɔ, kɛ anɔkuale ɔ nɛ nyɛ he ye ɔ nɔ.
Ejakaa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ buu dali a he, nɛ ke a fa kue ha lɛ ɔ, e nuɔ.
ni nɛmɛ nɛ piɛ ɔ, a ti ni komɛ nɛ a bu gbegbelihi a nɔ, nɛ ni komɛ hu a kpla lɛ ɔ he kɛ ya nu kpo. Bɔ nɛ pee nɛ mɛ tsuo a ya su kpo slɔkee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Wami ngɛ Munyu ɔ mi, nɛ wami nɛ ɔ ngɔ la ba ha nimli adesahi.
Herode kɛ e ta buli ɔmɛ ye Yesu he fɛu, nɛ a bɔ lɛ ahlua. A wo Yesu tade klɔii saminyayoo ko, nɛ Herode ha nɛ a kpale lɛ ya ha Pilato ekohu.
Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, hwɔ ba Egipt kɛ Kanaan zugba a tsuo nɔ, nɛ a na nɔ́ saminya. Wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ nɛ́ ní nɛ a ye.
Bɔfo ɔ de lɛ ke, “Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ maa ba o nɔ; Hiɔwe No ɔ he wami ɔ maa ba o nɔ. Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, bi klɔuklɔu ɔ nɛ o ma fɔ ɔ, a ma tsɛ lɛ Mawu Bi.
Ke nɔ ko ya tsu ní ngɛ he lo mi ɔ, e ma kpa nɔ́ nɛ puɛɔ nɛ ma kpata e hɛ mi. Jã kɛ̃ ke nɔ ko tsu ní ngɛ Mawu mumi ɔ nya, Mawu mumi ɔ ma ha e na neneene wami.
Kristo hé nyɛ kɛ jua wawɛ; nyɛ ko pee nyɛ he nimli a nyɔguɛhi.
Yesu pee okadi kpahi fuu ngɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ a hɛ mi nɛ a ngmɛ́ ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ mi.
Nyɛ kai nihi nɛ a wo mɛ tsu ɔ kaa nɔ́ nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ mɛ tsuo lɛ a wo tsu. Nyɛ kai nihi nɛ a ngɛ mɛ yi mi wae ɔ kaa nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ nitsɛmɛ mohu nɛ a ngɛ yi mi wae.
A ma bo tsu, nɛ a po mi enyɔ. A tsɛɛ bo tsu ɔ he nɛ a guu kɛ sɛɛ mi ɔ he klɔuklɔu. Kane tso, kɛ okplɔɔ kɛ e nɔ abolo klɛdɛɛ ɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Abosiami ngɔ lɛ kɛ ya hiɔwe, nɛ e kɛ je nɛ ɔ mi matsɛ yemi ɔmɛ tsuo tsɔɔ lɛ hɛngmɛfia.
Ye nyɛmimɛ, i kpa nyɛ pɛɛ, nyɛɛ kase mi. Nyɛ le, sa a, i ngɛ kaa nyɛ. Nyɛ pee we mi yayami ko.
Tsaatsɛmɛ! I ngɛ nyɛ womi nɛ ɔ ngmae, ejakaa nyɛ le nɔ nɛ ngɛ kɛ je sisije ɔ. Nihewi! I ngɛ nyɛ womi nɛ ɔ ngmae, ejakaa nyɛ ye nɔ yayami ɔ nɔ kunimi.
Nyɛ nihi nɛ nyɛ hlaa kaa nyɛ maa ye mlaa a nɔ, konɛ a dla nyɛɛ kɛ Mawu nyɛ kpɛti ɔ, pe nyɛ tsɔ nyɛ he kɛ je Kristo he ɔ nɛ. Enɛ ɔ tsɔɔ kaa nyɛ kua Mawu dloomi ɔ.
nɛ a maa je kpo kɛ je a yɔkɔ ɔmɛ a mi. A ti ni nɛmɛ nɛ pee kpakpa a, a maa te si, nɛ a maa hi si kɛ maa ya neneene; se ni nɛmɛ nɛ pee yayami ɔ lɛɛ a maa te si, konɛ a kojo mɛ.
Mawu nɛ le adesahi tsuo a juɛmi ɔ kplɛɛ nɔ kaa a fiɛ sane kpakpa a ha ma je li ɔmɛ hulɔ; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e ha mɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ kaa bɔ nɛ e ha wɔ ɔ.
Nɔ nɛ be mumi ɔ na we Mawu mumi ɔ nike níhi. Nɔmlɔ kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ nui mumi ɔ nike níhi a sisi saminya. Enɛ ɔmɛ peeɔ kuasiahi a sane kɛ haa lɛ; ejakaa ni nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, mumi mi hɛngmɛ a kɛ naa.
Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ya nɔ jeha enyɔ sɔuu, nɛ Yuda bi, kɛ ma je li tsuo nɛ a ngɛ Asia a nu Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ munyu ɔ.
Enɛ ɔ ha a ye gbeye kaa alini nɛ lɛ ɔ ma ya sa si ngɛ tɛ sa nɔ; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a fɔ̃ osɛkɛ eywiɛ ngɛ lɛ ɔ supa je kɛ ngɛ mlɛe nɛ je nɛ na mla.
Jehanɛ ɔ hu, yihi nɛ ngɛ wa kpɛti ɔ, a ti ni komɛ ha nɛ wa nya kpɛ wa he. Makɛ nɛ ɔ nɛ a ya yɔkɔ ɔ he ɔ,
Ke nɔ ko ba pee Kristo nɔ́ kɛkɛ e plɛ bɔ nɔ́ he; blema ní ɔmɛ tsuo be kɛ ho. Hyɛ, níhi tsuo pee e he.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, kaseli ɔmɛ pee a yi mi kaa a ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ ma tsu nɔ́ ko bɔ nɛ e ma nyɛ, konɛ a kɛ ya je ngmlaa ha nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ Yudea.
Benɛ e ye be saii ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, Festo bɔ matsɛ ɔ Paulo he sane ɔ. E de lɛ ke, “Felike je pã mi no ko he ngɛ tsu mi ngɛ hiɛ ɔ.
E he nɔ ke, “Nɔ nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe tade enyɔ ɔ, e ke nɔ nɛ be eko ɔ nɛ dla; nɛ nɔ nɛ ngɛ niye ní ɔ, lɛ hu e kɛ nihi nɛ dla ja nɔuu.”
Gabriel hɛɛ sɛ gbi kɛ ha yiheyo ko nɛ a bi e si ha Yosef, Matsɛ David nina a kake. Yiheyo ɔ biɛ ji Maria.
Ejakaa ke i ngɛ sɔlee ngɛ gbi slɔɔtohi a mi ɔ, ye mumi ɔ ngɛ sɔlee mohu, se imi nitsɛ lɛɛ i li nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ dee ɔ.
I le kaa e be kɛe kulaa nɛ ma gbo kaa bɔ nɛ wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo je tsɔɔ mi ɔ.
Yesu ya nɔ de ke, “Enɛ ɔ nɔuu he je nɛ i de nyɛ ke nɔ ko nɔ ko be nyɛe maa ba ye ngɔ kaa ja Tsɛ ɔ nitsɛ ha lɛ he blɔ ɔ nɛ.”
Ke nɔ ko ke, “Paulo nɔ ji mi”, nɛ nɔ ko hu ke, “Imi lɛɛ Apolo nɔ ji mi” ɔ, anɛ pi nɔ́ nɛ je mi bi peeɔ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ pee nɛ ɔ?
Maria de ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mawayo ji mi; bɔ nɛ o de ɔ, e ba mi ja.” Kɛkɛ nɛ bɔfo ɔ si lɛ.
Se o bi nɛ ɔ ya nyɛɛ yi yaholi a se, nɛ e kɛ kpata o weto ní tsuo hɛ mi. Mwɔnɛ ɔ nɛ e kpale kɛ ba a, tse o gbe na bi nɛ wo zɔ ɔ ngɔ ha lɛ!’
Kornelio he nɔ ke, “Mwɔnɛ ɔ ji ligbi eywiɛ, maa pee gbɔkuɛ ngmlɛ etɛ ɔ, i ngɛ sɔlee
Nihi tsuo nɛ sɛ ye hlami kɛ ba a, juli, kɛ ojo fiali ji mɛ; nɛ to ɔmɛ bui mɛ tue.
ejakaa nyɛ yi wami hemi ɔ nɛ e he nɛ nyɛ heɔ Mawu yeɔ ɔ, nyɛ nine maa su nɔ.
Nyɛɛ wo nɔmlɔ su he. Nɔmlɔ su he nɛ ɔ ji nɔ́ nɛ Mawu, e bɔlɔ ɔ ngɛ mɔde bɔe daa nɛ kaa e maa hi kaa bɔ nɛ lɛ Mawu ɔ ngɛ ɔ, kɛkɛ nyɛ maa le lɛ fitsofitso.
“Nyɛɛ ba! Nyɛ ba hyɛ nyumu ko nɛ de mi níhi tsuo nɛ i pee hyɛ. Anɛ pi lɛ ji Kristo ɔ lo?”
Melki bi ɔ, Adi bi ɔ, Kosam bi ɔ, Elmadam bi ɔ, Er bi ɔ,
Se ni komɛ hu de ke, “Nɔmlɔ nɛ mumi yayami ngɛ e mi be nyɛe maa tu munyu kikɛ nɛ ɔ. Kɛ mumi yayami ma nyɛ bli hɛ yuyuili a hɛngmɛ kɛɛ?”
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, benɛ a nya ba bua ngɛ hiɛ ɔ, i tui tsle, se e nɔ jena a, i ya hi kojomi sɛ ɔ nɔ, nɛ i fa ke a ngɔ nyumu ɔ kɛ ba.
ke e hyɛ a hɛ mi, nɛ e tsɔ nɛ a ya ngɔ Paulo kɛ ba Yerusalem; mɛɛ lɛɛ a so e yi nɔ nɛ a maa gbe lɛ ngɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ.
Nyɛ ko gbo ngma nɛ puɛɔ ɔ he dengme. Mohu ɔ, nyɛ hla ngma nɛ hii si kɛ yaa neneene. Enɛ ɔ ji nɔ́ nɛ Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ ma ha nyɛ ɔ nɛ, ejakaa Tsɛ Mawu ɔ nɛ hla lɛ.”
Nyumu nɛ ɔ huɛ ji Sergio Paulo, zugba a nɔ amlaalo ɔ. Sergio Paulo ɔ, nɔmlɔ nɛ hɛ mi ka si ji lɛ. Amlaalo ɔ tsɛ Barnaba, kɛ Saulo kɛ ba e ngɔ; ejakaa e suɔ kaa e maa bu Mawu munyu ɔ tue.

É pee yo nɛ he biɛ kaa e peeɔ kpakpa, yo nɛ nyɛ tsɔse bimɛ saminya, yo nɛ nyɛ hyɛ nibwɔhi nɛ ba to lɛ, yo nɛ sɔmɔ ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ kɛ he si bami, yo nɛ je nihi kɛ je haomi mi, nɛ ngɔ e be tsuo kɛ tsu ní kpakpahi.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Paulo ye jeha, kɛ nyɔhiɔ ekpa ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɛ e kɛ tsɔɔ ni ɔmɛ Mawu munyu ɔ.
Yuda bi hlaa kaa a pee okadi ha mɛ nɛ a na loko a he sɛ gbi ɔ nɛ a ye. Hela bi hu hlaa kaa a maa nu nile munyu ko ngɛ mi lo.
Se nɔ nɛ nyɛɛ e nyɛmi ɔ, e ngɛ diblii ɔ mi, nɛ e ngɛ diblii ɔ mi nyɛɛe nɛ́ e li he nɛ e yaa. Ejakaa diblii ɔ yu e hɛ.
Yuda bi ɔmɛ a nɔkɔtɔma ko ngɛ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Nikodemo. Farisi no ji lɛ.
“I ngɛ nyɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ dee, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ nyɛ ko ngmɛɛ nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ he.
Benɛ Maria nu enɛ ɔ, e te si pam, nɛ e je kpo esɔ, nɛ e kɛ Yesu ya kpe.
Niinɛ, kunya yemi nɛ ɔ nɛ haa ni ɔmɛ a nya kpɛɛ a he ɔ, Simon je sisi kɛ.
Ye kɔni tsuaa kɔni nɛ wui yiblii ɔ, e poɔ; se nɔ́ nɛ woɔ yiblii ɔ, e sãã he, konɛ e he nɛ tsɔ, nɛ e wo yiblii pe kekle ɔ.
Dloomi, mɔbɔ nami, kɛ he jɔmi nɛ je Tsɛ Mawu ɔ, kɛ Kristo Yesu, wa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ dɛ mi ɔ ha mo!
kɛ lɛ dami. A hlaa kaa a wo e nya tso kpɛ, konɛ e de nɔ́ ko nɛ sɛ́, nɛ a kɛ po e nya.
Nyɛɛ sɔle ha wɔ hulɔ, konɛ Mawu nɛ bli blɔ ha wɔ nɛ waa fiɛ e sɛ gbi nɛ kɔɔ Kristo he ɔ. Ejakaa Kristo laami sane nɛ ɔ he nɛ a wo mi tsu ngɛ.
A maa fia lɛ kpa, nɛ a maa gbe lɛ. Se ligbi etɛ se ɔ, e maa te si kɛ ba wami mi ekohu.”
Nɔ nɛ tsɛ nyɛ ɔ, anɔkualetsɛ ji lɛ; nɛ e maa pee hulɔ.

E ngɛ mi kaa he lo mi ɔ, i be nyɛ ngɔ lɛɛ, se mumi mi ɔ, i kɛ nyɛ ngɛ. Ke i hyɛ bɔ nɛ nyɛ toɔ níhi blɔ nya saminya, kɛ bɔ nɛ nyɛ fi si kpɛii ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ ngɛ Kristo mi ɔ mi ɔ, e peeɔ mi bua jɔmi.
Marta he nɔ ke, “Ee Nyɔmtsɛ, i heɔ yeɔ kaa mo ji Kristo ɔ nɛ! Mo ji Mawu Bi ɔ nɛ ma je ɔ mi ɔ nɛ.”
Sane kpakpa nɛ ɔ ji laami sane nɛ Mawu ngɔ laa yi nɔhi kɛ je blema lokoo, nɛ amlɔ nɛ ɔ lɛɛ e je ngɔ tsɔɔ e ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ.
nɛ a te si ngɔ wo e nyɔmtsɛ ɔ kɛ nɔ nɛ a pɔ lɛ nu ɔ.’
Tsɔɔ yalɔyi ɔmɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ, konɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko kó tu a he munyu yaya.
A ha hwɔ, nɛ a sɔle kɛ hla nikɔtɔmahi, nɛ a tu mɛ ngɔ wo Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nɛ a he ye ɔ dɛ mi.
Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ ba Filipo nɛ je Betsaida ngɛ Galilea a ngɔ, nɛ a ba de lɛ ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, wa ngɛ hlae nɛ waa na Yesu.”
Ejakaa benɛ Abraham kɛ Melkizedek kpe ɔ, Levi ngɛ e nɛ̃ Abraham mi mi kɛ mwɔɔ.
“Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, kɛ wai ngmɔtsɛ ɔ maa pee apaa yeli ɔmɛ kɛɛ?
Nihi nɛ kaa a kpɔhi a mi ɔ, a hɛ mi kaa si be tsuaa be, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ a ná jlasi nɛ puɛɔ. Se wɔɔ lɛɛ wa peeɔ jã, konɛ wa nine nɛ su jlasi nɛ puɛ we gblegbleegble ɔ nɔ.
Mawu, nɔ nɛ bɔ je ɔ, kɛ e mi níhi tsuo ɔ, lɛ ji hiɔwe kɛ zugba Nyɔmtsɛ; nɛ e hí sɔlemi tsu nɛ a kɛ nine pee mi.
nɛ Yason he mɛ ngɔ to we. A ngɛ Kaisare ɔ mlaa amɛ tsuo a nɔ tɔe; nɛ a ngɛ dee ke matsɛ kpa ko ngɛ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Yesu.”
Se Yesu na a juɛmi ɔ momo. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e de mɛ ke,
Jamɛ a tsɔlɔ ɔ nɛ ke e nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ba nɛ e ma ba na kaa e ngɛ ní tsue kikɛ nɛ ɔ, a gbaa lɛ!
I le kaa o buɔ mi tue be tsuaa be; se i ngɛ enɛ ɔ dee ngɛ nihi nɛ pueɔ si nɛ ɔ a he, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ a he ye kaa mo nɛ o tsɔ mi.”
Wa ngɛ kikɛmɛ a sane nɛ ɔmɛ a he odase yee; nɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ nɛ Mawu kɛ dloo nihi nɛ buɔ lɛ tue ɔ ngɛ odase yee ja nɔuu.”
Jehanɛ, e de Toma ke, “Ngɔɔ o nine nguɛ ba slaa ye dɛ mi nɛ o hyɛ; nɛ o kɛ o nine ba hɔ ye kasa mi. Kpa nɔ jemi, nɛ o he ye!”
Tlukaa a, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ bɔfo ko ba je e he kpo tsɔɔ mɛ. Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ hɛ mi nyami kpɛ kɛ bɔle mɛ, nɛ a ye gbeye wawɛɛ.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, a maa hɛli a he si, nɛ klama nɛ Abosiami tsɔ ha mɛ kaa a pee e suɔmi nya ní, nɛ a ya nɔ mi ɔ, a ya be mi nɔe.
(Anɔkuale mi ɔ, Yesu nitsɛ sɔle we nɔ ko, se e kaseli ɔmɛ mohu lɛ a sɔle nihi.)
Kaii mɛ kikɛmɛ a ní nɛ ɔmɛ. Bɔɔ mɛ kɔkɔ ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ hɛ mi ke a ko pɛ ngɛ munyuhi a he, ejakaa nɔ́ kpakpa ko ji mi kɛ bɛ, se mohu jamɛ a munyu ɔmɛ gbeɔ e nuli ɔmɛ a hemi kɛ yemi.
“Imi ji wai tso nitsɛ ɔ, nɛ Tsaatsɛ ji ngmɔtsɛ.
Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Yuda bi ɔmɛ ngɛ nyami ligbi yee ngɛ Yerusalem, nɛ Yesu ya lejɛ ɔ.
Mawu dloo Stefano saminya, nɛ e ha lɛ he wami nɛ e kɛ pee nyakpɛ ní nguanguahi ngɛ ma a mi.
Nihi nɛ ngɛ lahuɛhi juae ɔ, e de mɛ ke, “Nyɛ je ní nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ je hiɛ ɔ esɔ! Tsaatsɛ we ɔ, nyɛ ko ngɔ kɛ pee jua nɔ.”
Jehanɛ, i nu gbi ko nɛ de mi ke, ‘Petro, tee si, gbee eko nɛ o ye!’
Ye nyɛmimɛ, enɛ ɔ he ɔ, si himi mi tsuaa si himi mi nɛ nɔ ko ngɛ benɛ a tsɛ lɛ ɔ, e kɛ Mawu nɛ hi si jã.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ nyɛɔ e nyɛmi ɔ, nɔmlɔ gbelɔ ji lɛ; nɛ nyɛ le kaa nɔmlɔ gbelɔ ko nɔmlɔ gbelɔ ko be neneene wami nae.
Nimli kpekpemi ɔ a ti nɔ kake de Yesu ke, “Tsɔɔlɔ, de ye nyɛmi ɔ nɛ e kɛ mi nɛ dla gbosi ní ɔ.”
Se mohu ɔ, nyɛ ha nɛ nyɛ je mi bami he nɛ tsɔ kaa bɔ nɛ nɔ nɛ tsɛ nyɛ ɔ ngɛ klɔuklɔu ɔ.
“Benɛ wa ya a, tsu ɔ nya ngɛ ngangɛ. A ngmɛ mi kpɛii, nɛ buli ɔmɛ hu pee klaalo kɛ daa si ngɛ sinya a nya. Se benɛ wa bli ɔ, wa nɛ bɔfo ɔmɛ a ti nɔ ko nɔ ko!”
Yesu he nɔ ke, “Nɔ nɛ i ngɛ pee nɛ ɔ, amlɔ nɛ ɔ, o nui sisi; se pee se ɔ, o ma ba le.”
Wa kpa laami mi zo ní tsumi; wa yi kutupɔ, nɛ Mawu munyu ɔ hu wa tsakee we hɛ mi. Wa fiɛɔ Mawu sɛ gbi ɔ paa ngɛ ma hɛ mi, nɛ wa bɔɔ mɔde kaa nihi nɛ a ná wa he juɛmi kpakpa ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e sa nɛ e ba jã, konɛ nɔ́ nɛ a ngma ngɛ a mlaa a mi ke, ‘A nyɛ mi yaka gu’ ɔ nɛ ba mi.
A he nɔ ke, “Saminya! Tse mo hu Galilea no ji mo! Yaa kpa ngmami ɔmɛ a mi kaa o maa na gbalɔ ko nɛ je Galilea lo!”
Wa biɔ nyɛ hɛ mi nyɛɛli ɔmɛ, kɛ ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ tsuo. Ni nɛmɛ nɛ je Italia a hu ke a biɔ nyɛ.
Mumi ɔ nɛ Mawu haa nyɛ, kɛ nyakpɛ níhi nɛ e tsuɔ ha nyɛ ɔ, anɛ mlaa a nɔ nɛ nyɛ yeɔ ɔ he je, aloo sane kpakpa a nɛ nyɛ nuɔ nɛ nyɛ heɔ yeɔ ɔ?

Niatsɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti ɔ, nyɛɛ a nɔ nɛ a ko wo a he nɔ. Á ko ngɔ a hɛ ngɔ fɔ ní nɛ a na a nɔ, ejakaa ní nami se maa po. Á ngɔ a hɛ ngɔ fɔ Mawu mohu nɔ. Lɛ nɛ e haa wɔ ní kpakpahi babauu nɛ wa yeɔ faa.
Simon na kaa bɔfo ɔmɛ a nine nɛ a ngɔ pue nihi nɛ he ye ɔ a nɔ ɔ ha nɛ a na Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e je sika kɛ ha Petro kɛ Yohane,
Kɛ ba lɛ kɛɛ nɛ a ha mi he blɔ nguaa nɛ ɔ, kaa ye Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nyɛ ma ba slaa mi?
Kristo he odase nɛ nyɛ ngɛ yee ɔ ba he si wawɛɛ nɛ nihi na.
Kɛkɛ nɛ e wo fo kɛ ya na Simon Petro, kɛ kaselɔ kpa a nɛ Yesu suɔ lɛ ɔ ngɛ he nɛ a ngɛ ɔ. E de mɛ ke, “A wo Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ gbogboe kɛ je yɔkɔ ɔ mi, nɛ wa li he nɛ a kɛ lɛ ya fɔ.”
Kɛkɛ ɔ, nyɛ maa ba nyɛ je mi bɔ nɛ maa sa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ hɛ mi. Nyɛ ma tsu ní kpakpa sɔuu, nɛ nyɛ maa le Mawu saminya pe bɔ nɛ nyɛ le lɛ daa.
Ke nyɛ pee nɔ́ nɛ i de nyɛ ke nyɛɛ pee ɔ, lɔ ɔ lɛɛ ye huɛmɛ ji nyɛ.
I ngɛ to kpa komɛ hulɔ, se mɛɛ a piɛ we kuu nɛ ɔ he. Ma ngɔ mɛ hu kɛ ba; a maa nu ye gbi, nɛ a maa pee to kuu kake, kɛ hyɛlɔ kake.
Asafoatsɛ ɔ na Aleksandria lɛ ko ngɛ hiɛ ɔ nɛ yaa Italia, nɛ e je wɔ ngɔ wo mi.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, wa tsɔ Yuda, kɛ Sila, konɛ mɛ hu a ba jaje ní nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ wa ngma a nɔuu ngɔ tsɔɔ nyɛ.
Abraham to e tsui si, nɛ e nine su nɔ́ nɛ Mawu ke e ma ha lɛ ɔ nɔ.
Ma je li tete po a ke wa ko fiɛ ha mɛ, konɛ a ko he a yi wami. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, yayami ɔ, pe a ngɛ pee kɛ ngɛ nɔ toe babauu daa ligbi. Se jehanɛ lɛɛ Mawu kɛ e mi mi fumi ɔ kple a nɔ!
Je ɔ sɛ́ nimli nɛ ɔmɛ! A wo lalaalo ngɛ nga kplanaa nɔ, kɛ yohi a nɔ. A hi tɛ puɔhi, kɛ muɔhi a mi.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke nɔ ko ngɛ Kristo mi ɔ, e pee we yayami hu. Se nɔ nɛ ngɛ yayami pee kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ, e nɛ Kristo, nɛ e li lɛ hulɔ.
Biɛ kpakpa nɛ a wo nyɛ ɔ, anɛ pi mɛ nɛ a gbeɔ he guɛ ɔ?
Munyu nɛ e tu ɔ, anɛ pi wɔ tutuutu wa he nɛ e kɔɔ lo? Nihi nɛ gbaa ní, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ kpaa ní ɔ, e sa kaa a tsu ní kɛ hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi kaa mɛ hu a maa ye niba ní ɔ eko.
Nikodemo, nɔ nɛ be ko e ya Yesu ngɔ nyɔ mi ɔ, lɛ hu e ngɔ tsopa kɛ e he via, nɛ ji mire kɛ aloe nɛ a futu, nɛ jiimi maa pee kilo nyingmi etɛ kɛ ba, nɛ e piɛ Yosef he kɛ ho.
Benɛ Paulo je e nya kikɛ nɛ ɔ, Festo de kɛ ngmlaa kɛ wo lɛ ke, “Paulo, o yi mi ngɛ puɛe pɛ! Womi kasemi sɔuu lɛ wo mo godo nɛ ɔ nɛ!”
Se Petro he nɔ ke, “Awetsɛ, pi a ti nɔ kake ji mi!”
Nɛ ke e hia kaa imi hu ma ya a, i kɛ mɛ maa ya.
Nyɛ hu nyɛɛ piɛ wa he kɛ kpa pɛɛ, konɛ nihi babauu nɛ na Mawu si ha wɔ kaa nihi babauu a pɛɛ kpami nya a, wa na dloomi nike níhi.
Kristo ngɛ loko a bɔ níhi tsuo, nɛ lɛ nɛ ha nɛ níhi tsuo ngɛ a hanɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
I ngɛ gbeye yee kaa nɔ́ nɛ ba Hawa nɔ be ko ɔ maa ba nyɛ hu nyɛ nɔ. Sinɔ ya sisi Hawa, nɛ Hawa pee yayami. Jã kɛ̃ lɛ a ma puɛ nyɛ tue, nɛ nyɛ be Kristo anɔkuale yee kɛ pi si hu.
Yesu de ke, “I ngɛ nyɛ dee anɔkuale mi ke, ke to tsu ngɛ, nɛ nɔ ko ya kuɔ kɛ gu he kpa kɛ sɛ mi, se e gui to tsu ɔ nya a, jamɛatsɛ ɔ, julɔ kɛ ojo fialɔ ji lɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ kɛ kikɛmɛ a munyu nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ wo nyɛ sibi a bua.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke wa ngɛ nya mi ngma, kɛ heha ní kɛkɛ ɔ, e hiɛ ha wɔ hluu.
Tsɛ ɔ nitsɛ kojo we nɔ ko. E ngɔ jamɛ a he blɔ ɔ tsuo kɛ ha Bi ɔ, konɛ Bi ɔ nɛ kojo nihi.
E ngɛ mi kaa wa ngɛ he lo mi mohu, se kɛ̃ ɔ, wa pee we he lo nya ní.
Yihi enyɔ maa hi nɔ́ wɛɛe ngɛ he kake; a maa ngɔ nɔ kake kɛ je, nɛ a ma si nɔ kake ngɛ se.
Ma mi he nɛ a je ɔ, a ngɛ he susue jinɛ a ko na he blɔ nɛ a kpale kɛ ho lejɛ ɔ ya.
Benɛ Mawu ha nɛ e hi kɛ pi si ɔ, e ba pee nɔ nɛ haa nihi nɛ buɔ lɛ tue ɔ naa neneene yi wami hemi.
Nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ le sane ɔ nɛ ba ngɛ Yudea a tsuo momo; e je sisi kɛ je Galilea, kɛ je benɛ Yohane, nɔ sɔlelɔ ɔ fiɛ ɔ se.
Se wɔɔ lɛɛ Kristo nɛ a sɛu ɔ wa ngɛ fiɛe. Enɛ ɔ peeɔ blɔ tsimi nɔ ha Yuda bi, nɛ Hela bi hu buu lɛ kaa kuasiahi a sane.
Benɛ wai yiblii nya buami be su ɔ, e tsɔ e nyɔguɛ apaa yeli ɔmɛ a ngɔ, konɛ e ya ngɔ e blɔ fa mi nɔ́ ɔ ngɛ a dɛ kɛ ba. Se apaa yeli ɔmɛ fia nyɔguɛ ɔ ní, nɛ a ha nɛ e kpale e se kɛ ho dɛ gu.
Benɛ e na Petro kɛ Yohane nɛ a yaa sɛ sɔlemi we ɔ, e ba mɛ ní.
Benɛ Saulo nyɛɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ kɛ yaa, nɛ e su Damasko haa a, tlukaa a, la ko kpɛ kɛ je hiɔwe kɛ ba bɔle lɛ.
Jehanɛ ɔ, be ɔ ma, nɛ Mawu ma ha nihi he wami, konɛ a ja Tsɛ ɔ ngɛ mumi mi kɛ anɔkuale mi kaa bɔ nɛ Tsɛ ɔ nitsɛ suɔ. Pohu be ɔ su momo.

Nyɛ ngɛ nihi akpeakpe nɛ a ngɛ nyɛ nɔ hyɛe mohu, se nɛ nyɛ ba le Kristo ɔ, tsɛ kake pɛ lɛ nyɛ ngɛ. Ejakaa kɛ gu sane kpakpa a nɛ i ngɔ ba ha nyɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ, nyɛɛ kɛ Yesu Kristo ba bɔni bɔmi, nɛ i ba pee nyɛ tsɛ.
Anɛ i be ye dɛ he lo? Anɛ pi bɔfo ji mi lo? Anɛ i nɛ Yesu, wa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ lo? Nɛ nyɛ nɛɛ? Ní nɛ i tsu ha Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ, anɛ pi nyɛ ji nɔ́ nɛ je mi kɛ ba lo?
Benɛ e na lɛ ɔ, e kɛ lɛ ba Antiokia ekohu. A kɛ asafo ɔ hi si jeha mluku, nɛ a tsɔɔ nihi babauu ní. Antiokia ji he nɛ a wo nihi nɛ he ye ɔ biɛ ngɛ ke Kristo we bi.
Se Saulo ya nɔ nɛ e fiɛ kɛ he wami pe kekle ɔ po kɛ tsɔɔ kaa Yesu ji Kristo ɔ nɛ. Enɛ ɔ ha Yuda bi nɛ ngɛ Yerusalem ɔ a nya mi jɔ.
Mawu ɔ, nɔ ko nɛ lɛ hyɛ. E bi kake too ɔ nɛ hii si ngɛ Tsɛ ɔ hiɔ nɔ ɔ, lɛ nɛ e tsɔɔ wɔ bɔ nɛ Tsɛ ɔ ngɛ ha.
Petro hi Yopa be saii ngɛ lohwe he womi tsopa wolɔ ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Simon ngɔ.
A ha bɔfo ɔmɛ ba da a hɛ mi, nɛ a bi mɛ ke, “Kɛ nyɛ pee kɛɛ nɛ nyɛ tsa glɔtsɛ ɔ? Mɛnɔ he wami nya, aloo mɛnɔ biɛ mi nyɛ tsu nɔ́ nɛ ɔ?”
A maa ngɔ lɛ ngɔ wo ma je li a dɛ mi; ma je li ɔmɛ maa ye e he fɛu, nɛ a ma jɛ lɛ, nɛ a maa la lada ngɔ pue e nɔ.
i ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ ngmae kɛ ha mo Timoteo, ye bi nitsɛnitsɛ ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ mi.

Mawu lɛ je tsɔɔ mi kaa ma ya Yerusalem, nɛ i ya. I kɛ nihi nɛ a buu mɛ ɔ kɔklɔɔ ya kpe, nɛ sɛ gbi nɛ i ngɛ fiɛe ha ma je li ɔmɛ ɔ, i tsɔɔ mɛ nya, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ ní tsumi nɛ i tsu kɛ sɛ hlami, kɛ nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ tsue amlɔ nɛ ɔ pee yaka.
Jinɛ e susu kaa e nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ maa na kaa Mawu ngɛ e nɔ gue nɛ e kɛ kpɔ mɛ, se e ya bɛ mi ja.
Benɛ tsɔli ɔmɛ kpale kɛ ba a, osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ, kɛ Farisi bi ɔmɛ bi mɛ ke, “Mɛni he je nyɛɛ kɛ lɛ bɛ ɔ?”
Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ma je mi kɛ maa je ní yayamihi tsuo a mi, nɛ e kɛ mi maa ya hiɔwe he nɛ e ngɛ matsɛ yee ngɛ ɔ fiafiaafia. A maa wo e hɛ mi nyami kɛ maa ya neneene. Amen.
Jamɛ a be ɔ, nihi nɛ ngɛ Yudea a, a tu fo kɛ ya yo ɔmɛ a nɔ; nihi nɛ ngɛ ma a mi ɔ, a je, nɛ nihi nɛ ngɛ ngmɔ si ɔ, a ko ba ma a mi.

Waa ngɔ lɛ kaa waa kɛ Yesu ngɛ bɔe, nɛ wa ngɛ mɔde bɔe nɛ a gu lɔ ɔ nɔ nɛ a dla waa kɛ Mawu wa kpɛti. Ke wa ngɛ yayami pee kaa ma je li ɔmɛ nɔuu ɔ, anɛ enɛ ɔ tsɔɔ kaa Kristo náá yayami he bua jɔmi lo? Dɛbi.
Jinɛ i pi nɔ ko kulaa ngɛ ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ a kpɛti. Se Mawu ha mi dloomi nɛ ɔ kaa ma ya fiɛ sane kpakpa a ha ma je li ɔmɛ, nɛ ma tsɔɔ mɛ ní kpakpahi nɛ a ma na ke a ba nyɛɛ Kristo se.
Se a be bi; ejakaa Elizabet ɔ yosa ji lɛ, nɛ mɛ ni enyɔ ɔmɛ tsuo a bwɔ.
Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ nɔuu ɔ, Pilato kɛ Herode nu huɛ; jinɛ sa a, a kɛ a he yi.
Petro si agbo ɔ, nɛ yiheyo ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Roda a tu fo kɛ ba.
Ejakaa nihi nɛ a hɛ mi miɔ nɛ e ma kpata a, buɔ sɛ gbi ɔ nɛ kɔɔ sɛumi tso ɔ he ɔ kaa kuasiahi a sane ko kɛkɛ. Se wɔ nɛ a ngɛ wa yi wami hee ɔ, wɔɔ lɛɛ e ji Mawu he wami ha wɔ.
Farisi bi ɔmɛ a ti ni komɛ de ke, “Nɔmlɔ nɛ pee nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, pi Mawu ngɔ nɛ e je; ejakaa e bui Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ.”
Nɔ ko nɔ ko nɛ kó hla kaa e hi ha lɛ nɔ kake too; nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ susu e nyɛmi hu he.
Se Yesu he nɔ ke, “A gbaa ni nɛmɛ nɛ nuɔ Mawu munyu ɔ, nɛ a yeɔ nɔ ɔ mohu!”
Akɛnɛ wa suɔ kaa nyɛ nine nɛ su anɔkuale ɔ tsuo nɛ ngɛ sane kpakpa a mi ɔ nɔ sisiisi he je ɔ, wa ngɔɛ a munyu ɔ.
A ngɛ kaa jokuɛwi nɛ hii si ngɛ jua nɔ. Fa kake ngɛ ngmlaa kpae ngɛ a nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ dee ke, ‘Wa kpa bɛ ha nyɛ, se nyɛ dui! Wa nya awe, se nyɛ wui yana!’
Kɛ je Atalia a, a wó lɛ kɛ kpale a se kɛ ba Antiokia ngɛ Siria. Ní tsumi nɛ a gbe nya nɛ ɔ, hiɛ ɔ ji he nɛ a tu mɛ ngɔ wo Mawu dɛ mi ngɛ loko a je sisi.
Bua jɔmi nɛ nyɛ kɛ nya ye he jamɛ a be ɔ, jije e ngɛ amlɔ nɛ ɔ? Imi nitsɛ ma nyɛ ma ye odase kaa jamɛ a be ɔ, kaa e hi peemi ɔ, jinɛ nyɛ ko ta nyɛ hɛngmɛ tete po ngɔ ha mi.
Mɛ hu a ngɔ mɛ ya ha Roma kojoli ɔmɛ, nɛ a wo a he munyu ke, “Kikɛmɛ a nimli nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, Yuda bi ji mɛ, nɛ a ngɛ wa ma a mi hliihlii woe.
Nyɛ he nyɛ sibi atuu ngɛ nyɛ wehi a mi, nɛ nyɛ ko de ke nɔ́ nɛ ɔ peemi wa tsɔ.
Jehanɛ ɔ, a kpale bi lɛ ke, “Lɛɛ mɛnɔ ji mo mɔ? Tsɔɔ wɔ koo! Ejakaa nihi nɛ tsɔ wɔ ɔ, e hia kaa wa ya ha mɛ heto. Kɛ o deɔ ngɛ mo nitsɛ o he kɛɛ?”
Yesu de mɛ ke, “I heɔ yeɔ kaa nyɛ maa bu mi abɛ nɛ ɔ ke, ‘Tsopatsɛ, tsa mo nitsɛ o he.’ Nyɛ ma de mi hulɔ ke nihi nɛ nyɛ nu nɛ i pee ngɛ Kapernaum ɔ, ma pee ngɛ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ, ngɛ imi nitsɛ ye ma mi.”
Anɛ nyɛ kaii we kaa benɛ i kɛ nyɛ ngɛ ɔ, i de nyɛ kikɛmɛ a ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo lo?
Mawu pɛ ji mlaa wolɔ kɛ kojolɔ. Lɛ nɔ kake nɔuu pɛ lɛ e ngɛ he wami nɛ e kɛ heɔ nɔ yi wami, nɛ e kɛ kpataa nɔ hɛ mi hulɔ. Se moo lɛɛ mɛnɔ ji mo, nɛ o kojoɔ o nyɛmi adesa?
“Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, e be hiae kaa nyɛ bi mi nɔ́ ko hu. I ngɛ nyɛ dee anɔkuale mi ke, nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ he pɛɛ nɛ nyɛ ma kpa Tsɛ ɔ ngɛ ye biɛ mi ɔ, e maa pee ha nyɛ.
Benɛ e nu nihi babauu a he nɛ a bee ɔ, e bi ke, “Mɛni ba?”
Akɛnɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ lɛ tsɔ mɛ ɔ, Barnaba, kɛ Saulo pue nɔ kɛ ho Seleukia ya. A wó lɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ kɛ ho Kipro ya. Kipro ji zugba kpɔ nɛ nyu bɔle lɛ.
Se a maa bu akɔtaa ha Mawu, nɔ nɛ dla e he ngɔ to nɛ e maa kojo hɛ kali, kɛ ni gbogboehi tsuo ɔ.
Se e tsɛ ɔ de sɔmɔli ɔmɛ ke, ‘Nyɛ ya je tade klɔii saminyayoo ɔ kɛ ba wo lɛ esɔ. Nyɛɛ wo e nine nguɛ ga, kɛ e nane tokota.
Gbalɔ yo yomoyo kotokoto ko hi si nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Ana. E tsɛ biɛ ji Fanuel, nɛ e je Asher wɛtso ɔ mi. E kɛ e huno hi si jeha kpaago pɛ ngɛ e yihe mi,
kɛ la nɛ ngɛ tsoe plamplam. Nihi nɛ li Mawu, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ bui Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu sane kpakpa a, e kɛ mɛ maa to ní.
Nɛ nyu nɔuu, nyu kpekpemi ɔ a kɛ kpata jamɛ a be ɔ mi je ɔ hɛ mi.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke asafo ɔ tsuo nya ba bua, nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ bɔni gbi slɔɔtohi tumi, nɛ ni komɛ nɛ mɛɛ a li mi eko, aloo a he we yi ba lejɛ ɔ, anɛ a be dee ke nyɛ tsuo nyɛ ngɛ godo nue lo?
Ye bimɛ nɛ i suɔ, nyɛɛ hyɛ bɔ nɛ i ngɛ haoe ngɛ nyɛ he ekohu kaa yo nɛ nu kɔɔmi, hluu kɛ yaa su be nɛ a maa na subai nɛ ngɛ Kristo mi ɔ ngɛ nyɛ mi.
nɛ e tsɔ mɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu ngɔ ke a ya bi lɛ ke, “Mo lɛ a de ke o ma a, aloo waa hyɛ nɔ kpa blɔ?”
Benɛ Paulo kpale e se kɛ ya mɔ ɔ nɔ ɔ, e ku abolo, nɛ e ye. Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e kɛ ni ɔmɛ sɛɛ ní hluu kɛ ya si je mi tsɔ wɛsɛɛ; kɛkɛ nɛ e si mɛ.
Benɛ a kɛ mɛ hi si be bɔɔ se ɔ, nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ wo mɛ blɔ ngɛ he jɔmi mi kɛ ho nihi nɛ tsɔ mɛ ɔ a ngɔ ya.
Wa le kaa Mawu bui yayami peeli tue, se nɔ nɛ yeɔ lɛ gbeye, nɛ e peeɔ Mawu suɔmi nya ní ɔ, Mawu buɔ lɛ tue.
Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ nɔuu ɔ, a bɔni asafo ɔ nɛ ngɛ Yerusalem ɔ yi mi wami wawɛɛ. Nihi nɛ he ye ɔ tsuo gbɛ fĩa Yudea, kɛ Samaria kpokpa amɛ a nɔ; nɛ e piɛ bɔfo ɔmɛ pɛ.
Ma kpekpemi nɛ ɔ, a gbiɛ mɛ pɛ, ejakaa a li Mose mlaa a.”
Tlukaa a, zugba mimiɛ wawɛɛ, nɛ tsu ɔ, kɛ e sisi tomi ɔ tsuo mimiɛ. Amlɔ ɔ, sinya amɛ tsuo bli, nɛ kɔsɔkɔsɔ ɔmɛ kplɔ ngɛ pamitsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a he.
A tsɛɛ tsu mi pomi bo enyɔne ɔ se bo tsu ɔ he klɔuklɔu pe kulaa.
A bi kɛ ngmlaa ke, “Nubwɔ ko ngɛ we nɛ ɔ mi nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Simon Petro lo?”
Lɛ nɔuu nɛ a de ngɛ e he ke, “E ha nimli adesahi nike ní” ɔ nɛ. E pee ni komɛ bɔfohi, ni komɛ gbali, ni komɛ sane kpakpa fiɛli, ni komɛ osɔfohi, kɛ ni komɛ hu tsɔɔli.
Jehanɛ ɔ, e kɛ̃ abolo, nɛ e na Mawu si, nɛ e ku mi, nɛ e ngɔ ha mɛ, nɛ e de ke, “Enɛ ɔ ji ye nɔmlɔ tso [nɛ a ngɔ sã bɔ ha Mawu ngɛ nyɛ he. Nyɛɛ pee enɛ ɔ nɛ nyɛ kɛ kai mi.”
Niinɛ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ hlaa kaa e pee e he Mawu jalɔ nɛ le Kristo Yesu ɔ, a maa wa lɛ yi mi.
Se benɛ nyumu ɔ nu enɛ ɔ, nu lɛ, ejakaa e ngɛ ní babauu.
Mawu yeɔ anɔkuale, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ wa de nyɛ ɔ, pi “Ee” kɛ “Dɛbi” nɛ a deɔ be kake too ji lɔ ɔ.
O hemi kɛ yemi mi nɛ wa, nɛ o he nile nɛ hi hɛ ngmengmle. Ni komɛ ya bui a he nile tue, nɛ a hemi kɛ yemi ɔ ta.

Ejakaa pi he lo kɛ muɔ nɛ waa kɛ ngɛ ta hwue ɔ. He nyɛli nɛ waa kɛ mɛ ngɛ ta hwue ɔ ji nɔ yeli, kɛ nihi nɛ hɛɛ blɔ nyahi, mumi yayami kpetekpleenyɛhi nɛ ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi diblii ɔ mi, kɛ mumihi nɛ ngɛ kɔɔhiɔ mi nɛ peeɔ yi wu tso níhi.
Benɛ Paulo ngɛ munyu tue ɔ, nyumu ɔ bu lɛ tue saminya. Paulo hyɛ lɛ too, nɛ e na kaa nyumu ɔ ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi kaa a ma tsa lɛ.

Ni ɔmɛ yi ní be saii enɛ ɔ ha Paulo te da si nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Tsaatsɛmɛ, jinɛ e sa kaa nyɛ ko bu mi tue, nɛ a ko hiɛ lɛ ɔ kɛ ji Kreta. Jinɛ wa ko ba nɛ nɔ́, nɛ níhi a hɛ mi hu ko ba kpataa we kikɛ nɛ ɔ.
Se bɔfo ɔ de mɛ ke, “Nyɛ ko ye gbeye! I hɛɛ manye munyu nɛ ma ha Israel ma a tsuo ma na bua jɔmi babauu kɛ ha nyɛ.
Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, gbiɛ ɔ fɔɔ si ngɛ tso si poku ɔmɛ a nɔ momo; tso tsuaa tso nɛ wui yiblii kpakpa a, a maa po, nɛ a ma sake ngɔ fɔ la mi.”
Mɛ ji Simon, nɔ nɛ e wo lɛ biɛ ke Petro hulɔ ɔ, kɛ e nyɛmi Andrea, Yakobo kɛ Yohane, Filipo kɛ Bartolomeo,
Nyɛ ko suɔ je ɔ, loo níhi nɛ ngɛ je ɔ mi ɔ. Ke nɔ ko suɔ je ɔ, lɛɛ e sume Tsɛ ɔ.
nɛ a kplã si ngɛ e hɛ mi, nɛ a ye e he fɛu ke, “Yuda bi a matsɛ, manye oo manye!” Nɛ a gba e hɛ mi ma.
Musu tloo mɛ pɛ! A ya ngɔ Kain blɔ ɔ. Yayami nɛ Balaam pee ɔ, a ngɔ a he ya wo jamɛ a yayami ɔ mi ngɛ se nami he. A tsɔ atuã kaa bɔ nɛ Kora tsɔ atuã a, nɛ a hɛ mi kpata kaa lɛ.
Nyɛ le suɔmi agbo nɛ wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo ngɛ kɛ ha wɔ. Niatsɛ mi niatsɛ ji lɛ. Se nyɛ he ɔ, e pee e he ohiatsɛ, konɛ nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛɛ pee niatsɛmɛ.
Ke nyɛ nimli yayamihi po nyɛ le bɔ nɛ nyɛ haa nyɛ bimɛ ní kpakpahi ɔ, nyɛ Tsɛ nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ lɛɛ e maa ngɔ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ kɛ ha nihi nɛ biɔ lɛ ɔ kulaa pe kikɛ nɛ ɔ po!”
Ejakaa e hi kaa nɔ ko maa pee kpakpa nɛ e na amanehlu, ke lɔ ɔ ji nɔ́ nɛ Mawu suɔ ɔ, pe nɔ́ nɛ e maa pee yayami.
Nyɛ ha nɛ mi mi doomi, hɛdɔ, mi mi la, kɛ muklii mi fumi se nɛ po ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti. Nyɛɛ ngmɛɛ pɛ, kɛ nɔ jɛmi basabasa, kɛ ninyɛ tsuo he.
Kɛkɛ nɛ a bɔni a he bimi ke a kpɛti mɛnɔ po maa pee nɔ́ nɛ ɔ.
Kusumi komɛ nɛ a ngɛ tsɔɔe ɔ, a kɛ wa mlaa amɛ yɛ. Roma bi ji wɔ; wa be kusumi nɛ ɔmɛ ngɔe, nɛ waa kɛ be ní tsue hulɔ.”
“Ma ha nɛ ní leli a nile ma puɛ, nɛ ga leli a ga tsuo maa pee yaka.”
Nikodemo bi Yesu ke, “Nɔmlɔ nɛ wa a, kɛ maa pee kɛɛ nɛ a ma fɔ lɛ ekohu? Anɛ e ma nyɛ kpale sɛ e nyɛ mi mi nɛ a dla fɔ lɛ nɔ nɛ ji si enyɔ lo?”
Mɛ tsuo a ya nu kpe he ɔ nɔkɔtɔma nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Sostene ɔ ngɛ kojomi he ɔ hɛ mi, nɛ a fia lɛ ní. Se nɔ́ nɛ a pee nɛ ɔ si we Galio kpu.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yesu kpale de ekohu ke, “I ngɛ nyɛ dee anɔkuale mi ke imi ji to tsu ɔ nya agbo ɔ nɛ.
Festo he nɔ ke, “Hwɔɔ ɔ, ma ha nɛ o ba bu lɛ tue.”
“I kpa nyɛ tsuo nyɛ nɔ, nɛ i fiɛ Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ he sane ɔ tsɔɔ nyɛ. Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, i le kaa nyɛ ti nɔ ko be mi nae hu.
E ngɛ kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ. Nyumu ko ngɔ sinapi wu ya du ngɛ e ngmɔ mi. E puɛ, nɛ e pee tso agbo, nɛ lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ ba pee a tsu ngɛ e kɔni ɔmɛ a nɔ.”
Nyɛ le kaa Kristo ba, konɛ e ba wó wa he yayami ɔmɛ kɛ ho. Nyɛ le hulɔ kaa Kristo ɔ, yayami ko be e he.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Yesu ngɔ tangme tsɔwi kɛ pee kpa, nɛ e fie jua yeli ɔmɛ, kɛ a to ɔmɛ, kɛ na amɛ tsuo kɛ je sɔlemi we ɔ. E tsitsɛɛ sika tsakeli ɔmɛ a we okplɔɔ ɔmɛ ngɔ fia si, nɛ e plɛ a sika amɛ ngɔ pue si.
Pilato bi lɛ ke, “Anɛ Yuda no ji mi? Mo nitsɛ o ma mi bi, kɛ osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ nɛ a ngɔ mo ba ha mi. Mɛni o pee?”
E nɔ jena a, waa kɛ Paulo ya Yakobo ngɔ. Wa ya na asafo nikɔtɔma amɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.
Pi ni ɔmɛ tsuo ji bɔfohi, loo Mawu sɛ gbi fiɛli, loo tsɔɔli. Pi nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ngɛ he wami nɛ a kɛ peeɔ nyakpɛ ní.
Yesu he nɔ ke, “Nɔ́ nɛ adesa nyɛ we peemi ɔ, Mawu lɛɛ e nyɛɔ peeɔ.”
A de ke, “Mawu nɛ gbaa matsɛ ɔ nɛ ma ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ biɛ mi ɔ! He jɔmi ngɛ hiɔwe, kɛ hɛ mi nyami ha Mawu!”
Bɔfo ɔmɛ nɛ a he wa, nɛ a hiɛ kulaa pe lakpa tsɔɔli nɛ ɔmɛ tete po pui a nya, nɛ a jɛ we mɛ hulɔ ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ hɛ mi.
Wɔɔ lɛɛ bɔ nɛ Kristo susuu e yi mi ɔ, jã wɔ hu wa susuu wa yi mi.
Nyɛɛ bu nɔ tsuaa nɔ; nyɛɛ suɔ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ nɛ ngɔ a he ngɔ ha Kristo ɔ; nyɛɛ ye Mawu gbeye, nɛ nyɛɛ bu matsɛ ɔ.
Se nyɛ mohu nyɛ ngɛ nyɛ sibi yayami pee, nɛ nyɛ ngɛ nyɛ sibi sisie, nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ nyɛmimɛ tete po.
Nyumu ɔ he nɔ ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, i heɔ yeɔ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ e kpla si ngɛ Yesu hɛ mi.
Jehanɛ ɔ, Yesu de e kaseli ɔmɛ ke, “Waa ngɔ lɛ kaa nyɛ ti nɔ kake ya e huɛ ngɔ nyɔ mi kpɛti ya de lɛ ke, ‘Ye huɛ, paa mi abolo etɛ.
Anɔkuale sane ji kaa ke nɔ ko suɔ kaa e maa hyɛ Mawu asafo nɔ ɔ, e na ní tsumi kpakpa.
nɛ nihi je kpo kɛ ba, konɛ a ba hyɛ. Benɛ a ba su Yesu ngɔ ɔ, a na nyumu ɔ nɛ mumi yayami ɔmɛ je e mi ɔ nɛ e hii si ngɛ Yesu nane nya. E wo tade, nɛ e hɛ mi tsɔ lɛ. Nɛ mɛ tsuo a ye gbeye.
Mawu nɛ́ je wɔ kɛ je gbenɔ muɔ nya kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ ngɛ wɔ jee kɛ mwɔɔ; nɛ e ma je wɔ ekohu. Wa ngɔ wa hɛ kɛ fɔ e nɔ kaa e maa kpale je wɔ kulaa.
Petro tu munyu kpahi fuu kɛ ye odase, nɛ e kɛ wo mɛ ga ke, “Tue gblami nɛ yi nɔ nɛ ɔ bi yayami peeli ma na a, nyɛɛ hyɛ saminya nɛ e kó ba nyɛ nɔ.”
E hia kaa nyɛɛ to nyɛ tsui si, nɛ nyɛɛ pee Mawu suɔmi nya ní, konɛ nɔ́ nɛ e wo he si ɔ, nyɛ nine nɛ su nɔ.
Pi nyɛ nɛ nyɛ hla mi. Imi mohu nɛ i hla nyɛ nɛ i tsɔ nyɛ, konɛ nyɛ ya wo yiblii nɛ maa hi si daa. Kɛkɛ ɔ, nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ ma kpa he pɛɛ ngɛ ye biɛ mi ɔ, Tsɛ ɔ ma ha nyɛ.
Nyagbe ɔ, Yesu bi mlaa tsɔɔlɔ ɔ ke, “Kɛ o susuɔ kɛɛ? Ni etɛ nɛ ɔmɛ a kpɛti ɔ, mɛnɔ ji nɔmlɔ nɛ ojo fiali ɔmɛ ya tua lɛ ɔ e nyɛmi?”
I ngɛ ye ní pee kaa kuasia; se nyɛ lɛ nyɛ pee mi jã. Nyɛ lɛ nyɛ ko je ye yi; ejakaa ke i pi nɔ ko tete po, jamɛ a ni ɔmɛ nɛ nyɛ buu mɛ bɔfo nguahi ɔ, a pi mi ngɛ nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko mi.

Tlukaa a, wo nɔ kɔɔhiɔ ko hia ba kpee mɛ. A tsɛɛ kɔɔhiɔ nɛ ɔ ke, “Omleyi kɛ beleku kɔɔhiɔ.”
Wa heɔ yeɔ kaa Yesu gbo, nɛ e te si ekohu. Jã kɛ̃, wa heɔ yeɔ kaa ke Yesu ma a, Mawu maa ngɔ nihi nɛ gbo ɔ ngɔ piɛ e he kɛ ba.

Kornelio hyɛ lɛ too; gbeye nu lɛ, nɛ e bi ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, mɛni sane?”
Nyumu ɔ de mɛ ke, “Mɛni nyakpɛ sane ji nɛ ɔ! Nɔmlɔ nɛ bli ye hɛngmɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ ke nyɛ li he nɛ e je!
Mawu ɔ nɛ i ngɛ sɔmɔe kɛ ye tsui tsuo kaa bɔ nɛ ye nɛmɛ ɔmɛ pee ɔ, i naa lɛ si. Daa nyɔ kɛ pia ke i ngɛ sɔlee ɔ, i kaiɔ mo.
Be bɔɔ se ɔ, nyumu ko hu yo Petro, nɛ e de ke, “Mo hu a ti nɔ kake ji mo!”
Jehanɛ, Petro kɛ Yohane ngɔ a nine pue ni ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ a na Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ.
Kikɛmɛ a su nɛ ɔmɛ a he hia nyɛ, nɛ ke nyɛ na mɛ bɔ nɛ sa a, nyɛ ma tsu ní nɛ maa wo yiblii saminya, nɛ nyɛ he maa ba se nami, akɛnɛ nyɛ le wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo ɔ.
Mumi yayamihi hu je nihi fuu a mi, nɛ a kpa ngmlaa ke, “Mo ji Mawu Bi ɔ nɛ!”
Nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ ngmae nɛ ɔ, Mawu ji ye we odase kaa i yi lakpa.
Se enɛ ɔmɛ lɛɛ a ngma, konɛ nyɛ he ye kaa Yesu ji Kristo, Mawu Bi ɔ. Nɛ ke nyɛ he lɛ ye ɔ, nyɛ yi ma na wami.
Jehanɛ ɔ, nihi nɛ buu a he dali, nɛ a gbee ni kpahi a he guɛ ɔ, Yesu tu munyu ngɛ abɛ gbi kɛ tsɔɔ mɛ. E ke,
Osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ ba de Pilato ke, “Koo ngma ke, ‘Yuda bi ɔmɛ a matsɛ ɔ.’ Se mohu ngmaa ke, ‘Nɔmlɔ nɛ ɔ de ke lɛ ji Yuda bi ɔmɛ a matsɛ ɔ nɛ.’ ”
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e fɔɔ si paa kaa he jɔɔmi be ko ngɛ ha Mawu ma a nɛ a maa ye.
Gbi ko de lɛ ke, “Petro, tee si; gbee eko nɛ o ye!”
Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, i daa si ngɛ hiɛ ɔ nɛ a ngɛ mi kojoe kaa si ko nɛ Mawu wo wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ be ko ɔ, i heɔ yeɔ.
Tso tsuaa tso ɔ, lɛ nitsɛ e yiblii a kɛ leɔ lɛ; a la we ngmɔkɔ ngɛ mio tso nɔ; nɛ jehanɛ hu, a bua we wai yiblii nya kɛ ji zezle mi.
Ejakaa i jaje Mawu yi mi tomi ɔ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ ngɔ tsɔɔ nyɛ nɛ i laa we nyɛ ba.
Tsɔlɔ ɔ de ngɛ e yi mi ke, ‘Ye nyɔmtsɛ ɔ miɔ nɛ e ma kpɔ ní tsumi ɔ ngɛ ye dɛ; kɛ ma pee kɛɛ? I be nɔmlɔ tso mi he wami nɛ ma nyɛ ní tsumi kpakpataa ma tsu, nɛ nɔ́ bami hu maa pee mi zo.
Benɛ wa ba su Roma a, a ngmɛ Paulo blɔ nɛ lɛ nitsɛ e hi e dɛ he, kɛ ta bulɔ kake nɛ ngɛ e he bue.
Se nɔ ko ma de ke, “Moo lɛɛ o hɛɛ hemi kɛ yemi, nɛ imi lɛɛ i tsuɔ ní” Yoo, tsɔɔ mi o hemi kɛ yemi nɛ o tsu we he ní ɔ, nɛ imi hu i kɛ níhi nɛ i tsuɔ ɔ maa tsɔɔ mo kaa i heɔ yeɔ.
A nyɛ we nɛ a wo e nya tso kpɛ ngɛ ma a hɛ mi, ejakaa heto nɛ e ha mɛ ɔ ha nɛ a he mi po. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a ma a nya.
Kɛkɛ nɛ i kai kaa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ tu munyu nɛ ɔ ke, ‘Yohane ɔ, nyu e kɛ sɔle ni ɔmɛ, se nyɛɛ lɛɛ Mawu maa ngɔ Mumi Klɔuklɔu kɛ sɔle nyɛ.’
Nyakpɛ níhi nɛ bɔfo ɔmɛ pee he je ɔ, ke pee ɔ, nihi ngɔɔ hiɔtsɛmɛ kɛ a sa kɛ baa gbɛjegbɛ tue, konɛ ke Petro bee ɔ, e nini kɛkɛ po nɛ nɔ a nɔ.
Se kɛ ba si be nɛ ɔ tsuo Kristo asafo ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ Yudea a li mi hɛ mi kɛ hɛ mi.
Wa yi nɔ ko ní yaka nɛ́ wa wui he hiɔ; mohu ɔ, wa tsu ní kɛ pɔtɔ. Wa tsu ní nyɔ kɛ pia, konɛ wa ko pee tlomi ha nyɛ ti nɔ ko.
Ye nyɛmi nɛ i suɔ saminya! Dengme nɛ o ngɛ gboe ngɛ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ a he, titli nibwɔ ɔmɛ ɔ, o tsui tsuo o kɛ ngɛ ní nɛ ɔ tsue.
Se hiɔwe kɛ zugba a nɛ ngɛ amlɔ nɛ ɔ, munyu nɛ je Mawu nya a nɔuu lɛ hɛɛ mɛ, konɛ a kɛ la nɛ ba kpata a hɛ mi hwɔɔ se. Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, a maa kojo nihi tsuo nɛ li Mawu, nɛ a ma kpata a hɛ mi.
Se nɔ́ nɛ pe lɛ tsuo ji kaa e nu Yohane ngɔ wo tsu mi.
A de enɛ ɔ, konɛ Yesu munyu nɛ e tu kɛ tsɔɔ gbenɔ nɛ e ma gbo ɔ nɛ ba mi.
Nɔ nɛ tsɔ mi ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ e suɔ ji kaa nihi tsuo nɛ e tu ngɔ wo ye dɛ mi ɔ, ngmelu kake kó je mi; se mohu nyagbe ligbi ɔ, ma tle mɛ tsuo si.
Jehanɛ ɔ, wai ngmɔtsɛ ɔ de ke, ‘Kɛ ma pee kɛɛ? Ma tsɔ imi nitsɛ ye binyumu nɛ i suɔ lɛ ɔ; eko ɔ, a maa bu lɛ!’
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ jajeɔ paa kaa Yesu ɔ, Mawu Bi ji lɛ ɔ, Mawu hii e mi, nɛ lɛ hu e hii Mawu mi.
A ma de ke, ‘Nyumu nɛ ɔ je mɔ mami sisi, se e nyɛ we nɛ e gbe nya.’
Anɛ nyɛ li kaa ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ lɛ maa kojo je ɔ lo? Saminya! Ke nyɛ lɛ nyɛ maa kojo je ɔ, lɛɛ sane wawi kojomi pi nɔ́ ko kulaa ha nyɛ.
Kikɛmɛ a Mose nɛ ɔ nɛ de Israel bi ɔmɛ ke, ‘Nyɔmtsɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ maa tsɔ gbalɔ ko kɛ je nyɛ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ a kpɛti kaa bɔ nɛ e tsɔ mi ɔ nɛ.’
Lejɛ ɔ nɛ e ngɛ mlɛe ngɛ kɛ yaa si Mawu maa ngɔ e he nyɛli ɔmɛ kɛ pee nɔ́ nɛ e kɛ e nane maa nɔ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ nyumu ɔ nitsɛ de mɛ ke, “Imi ji lɛ.”
Kɛkɛ nɛ e ngɔ Paulo kɛ Sila kɛ ya e we ɔ mi, nɛ e ya ha mɛ ní nɛ a ye. E kɛ e we ɔ tsuo nya kaa jehanɛ ɔ e he Mawu ye.
Benɛ e de enɛ ɔ, mɛ tsuo a muɔ lɛ, ejakaa mɛɛ a le kaa jokuɛ ɔ gbo.
Se kekleekle ɔ, ja e na amanehlu babauu, nɛ kikɛmɛ a yi nɔ bi nɛ ɔmɛ kua lɛ.
Ke nyɛ ya he ko nɛ a he we nyɛ atuu ɔ, loko nyɛ maa je ma a mi ɔ, nyɛ blɛ nyɛ nane sisi zu kɛ pue si kɛ to mɛ okadi kaa a maa gbla a tue.”
nɛ i sɛ kaa a tsɛɔ mi o bi hu; ngɔɔ mi kɛ pee o we apaatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake.’
A ngɛ ngmlaa kpae ke, “Yesu lee! Tsɔɔlɔ lee! Naa wɔ mɔbɔ oo, naa wɔ mɔbɔ!”
Nyɛ kai bɔ nɛ nyɛ hi si sa a. Benɛ nyɛ ba le Mawu ɔ, nyɛɛ kɛ hɛ mi miami na amanehlu babauu.
I ngɛ mo ní nɛ ɔmɛ ngmae, se e be kɛe nɛ ma ba o ngɔ.
Benɛ e yó Petro gbi ɔ, bua jɔmi sɔuu nɛ e na he je ɔ, e bli we agbo ɔ, se mohu e tu fo kɛ ho ya de ke Petro daa si ngɛ agbo ɔ se.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e hia kaa wa je Mawu yi daa. Wɔ nihi nɛ wa heɔ Mawu yeɔ ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ waa kɛ wa nya jaje ɔ kɛ jeɔ e Bi ɔ yi ɔ ji bɔ nɛ wa ngɛ sãe ha Mawu kɛ gu Yesu Kristo nɔ ɔ nɛ.
E ko pee e he dã delɔ; nɛ e ko pee nɔ nɛ hɛ mi jɔɛ, loo nɔ nɛ suɔ pɛ. E ko pee e he sika suɔlɔ.
Ejakaa huno ɔ ngɛ e yo ɔ nɔ he wami kaa bɔ nɛ Kristo hu ngɛ asafo ɔ nɔ he wami ɔ. Kristo ngɔ e wami ngɔ ha, nɛ e kɛ he asafo ɔ yi wami; ee, asafo ɔ ngɛ kaa Kristo nitsɛ e nɔmlɔ tso.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ ko be nyɛe ma de ke a sɔle nyɛ kɛ wo ye biɛ mi.
Ye bimɛ, be nɛ i kɛ nyɛ maa hi si kɛ yaa si ɔ pi saasaa. Nyɛ ma hla mi, se kaa bɔ nɛ i de Yuda ma nimeli ɔmɛ ɔ, ‘He nɛ i yaa a, nyɛ be nyɛe maa ba.’
I le Kristo se nyɛɛlɔ ko nɛ a sa lɛ kɛ ya hiɔwe lokoo ɔ jeha nyɔngma kɛ eywiɛ ji nɛ. E ngɛ nɔmlɔ tso mi jio, e be nɔmlɔ tso mi jio, i li; Mawu lɛ le.
Se niinɛ, ní nami agbo ji Mawu jami, ke nɔ ko bua jɔ e níhi a he ɔ.
Yesu de lɛ ke, “O na lɛ momo. Lɛ ji nɔmlɔ nɛ kɛ mo ngɛ munyu tue ɔ nɛ.”
Ke a pu nɔmlɔ tso ɔ, e ngɛ tãi, nɛ e gbɔjɔ; se ke Mawu ma tle lɛ si kɛ ba wami mi ekohu ɔ, e maa hi fɛu, nɛ e he maa wa.
Nihi nɛ jaa Mawu ɔ, kaa a je a he yayami ɔmɛ niinɛ ɔ, a he nile be mɛ fɔ bue ngɛ a he yayami he hu, nɛ e be hiae kaa a sã bɔ hu.
Mohu ɔ, e hia kaa waa kɛ anɔkuale yemi nɛ suɔ wa sibi. Kɛkɛ ɔ, wa maa wa ngɛ mumi mi, nɛ wa maa hi kaa Kristo nɛ lɛ ji asafo ɔ yi ɔ.
Se Yesu he nɔ ke, “Koo doo e nya; e pee nɔ nɛ ɔ ngɔ to ye pumi be.
Ke Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ, nyɛ poɔ nɔ, konɛ a ko tɔ Mose mlaa a, mɛni he je nyɛ mi mi fuɔ mi kaa i tsa hiɔtsɛ Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ?
Jehanɛ hu, sanehi nɛ a kɛ fɔ ye nɔ nɛ ɔ, a be nya nyɛe maa tsɔɔ kaa a ngɛ mi.
Yuda bi ɔmɛ kpale tsɛ nyumu ɔ nɛ a fɔ lɛ hɛ yuyuilɔ ɔ ekohu, nɛ a bi lɛ ke, “Ka wɔ kita ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi ngɛ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ kaa o maa tu wɔ anɔkuale!
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e kɛ mɛ je kpo, nɛ e bi ke, “Tsaatsɛmɛ, kɛ ma pee kɛɛ nɛ́ a he ye yi wami?”
A yo lɛ si kake too; kɛkɛ nɛ e laa mɛ, nɛ a nɛ lɛ hu.
Sa a, be nɛ nyɛ nitsɛmɛ hu nyɛ ba nyɛ je mi ja a, kikɛmɛ a akɔnɔ nɛ ɔmɛ nɔuu a se nyɛ ya nyɛɛ.
Marta ngɛ nyɛmiyo ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Maria. Maria ba hi si ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nane nya, nɛ e ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ e ngɛ dee ɔ tue bue.
Ke a fɔ lɛ ɔ, o ma nya, nɛ o ma na bua jɔmi, nɛ nihi babauu ma nya ja nɔuu.
I na bua jɔmi babauu kaa Stefana, kɛ Fortunato, kɛ Akaiko ba hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ. Ejakaa nɛ nyɛ be ye ngɔ ngɛ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ ko pee ha mi ɔ, a ngɛ pee pɛpɛɛpɛ.
E kpɔ wɔ kɛ je diblii he wami ɔ sisi, nɛ e kɛ wɔ ba e Bi nɛ e suɔ lɛ saminya a matsɛ yemi ɔ mi.
Yesu de mɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ ya nɛ nyɛ ya de jamɛ a kɔkɔbo ɔ ke, ‘I ngɛ mumi yayamihi hiae, nɛ i ngɛ nihi tsae mwɔnɛ ɔ kɛ hwɔɔ, nɛ ligbi etɛne ɔ, ma gbe ye ní tsumi ɔ nya.’
Niinɛ, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke Yohane nɔ sɔlelɔ ɔ, nɔmlɔ adesa ko hí si hyɛ nɛ pe lɛ. Se kɛ̃ ɔ, nɔ nɛ ji nyafii pe kulaa ngɛ hiɔwe matsɛ yemi ɔ mi ɔ pe Yohane.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa je Kristo sane kpakpa a se ya tsɔɔ nɔ́ kpa a, e li Mawu. Nɔ nɛ tsɔɔ sane kpakpa a pɛpɛɛpɛ kaa bɔ nɛ e ngɛ kɛ je sisije ɔ, jamɛ a nɔ ɔ le Tsɛ ɔ, kɛ Bi ɔ tsuo.
Nyɛ ko bu lɛ he nyɛlɔ, se mohu nyɛɛ tu munyu ngɔ tsɔɔ lɛ kaa nyɛmi.
Nɛ akɔnɔ ɔ, ke e ngɔ hɔ ɔ, e fɔɔ yayami, nɛ yayami hu ke e wa a, e fɔɔ gbenɔ.
A ma kpata o hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ, nɛ nihi nɛ ngɛ ma a mi hu a maa gbe mɛ tsuo; a be tɛ kake po sie ngɛ e blɔ he. Ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo maa ba o nɔ, ejakaa be ɔ nɛ Mawu ba nɛ e ba kpɔ mo ɔ, o kplɛɛ we.”
Matsɛ Agripa, i ngɛ munyu tue kɛ kã kɛ ngɛ mo tsɔɔe, ejakaa o le sane nɛ ɔmɛ a mi. I he we yi kaa ní nɛ ɔmɛ eko ngɛ nɛ a kɛ laa mo; ejakaa a pee we ekoeko ngɛ kɔkɔɔmi.
Se Mawu ma tle nɔ tsuaa nɔ si ngɛ be nɛ sa mi. Kekleekle nɔ ji Kristo, nɛ lɔ ɔ se ke Kristo ma a, a ma tle e we bi ɔmɛ hu si.
Wa ko fiɛ yakayaka fiɛmi kaa bɔ nɛ a ti ni komɛ pee, nɛ nimli akpe nyingmi enyɔ kɛ etɛ gbo ligbi kake ɔ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ mumi yayami ɔmɛ de Yesu ke, “Wa kpa mo pɛɛ, ko ha nɛ wa ya sɛ muɔ voo ɔ nɛ ngɛ zugba a sisi ɔ mi.”
Yesu he nɔ ke, “He nɛ nɔ́ gbogboe fɔɔ si ngɛ ɔ, lejɛ ɔ okpokuhi ma bua a he nya ngɛ.”
Yesu kaseli ɔmɛ ya tsɛ̃ɛ̃ lɛ, nɛ a de ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, Nyɔmtsɛ! Wa gbo oo!”
Wa le kaa nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ji Mawu bi ɔ, e bua jɔɛ yayami peemi he. Ejakaa Mawu Bi ɔ baa e yi, nɛ Abosiami na we e he blɔ.
Se mɛɛ lɛɛ benɛ a nu munyu nɛ ɔ, a bɔni jemi kakaaka, kɛ je nɔkɔtɔma a nɔ kɛ ya si e piɛ Yesu, kɛ yo ɔ pɛ nɛ daa si ngɛ lejɛ ɔ kɛ mwɔɔ.
Mlaa nɛ Kristo wo wɔ ji nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ suɔ Mawu ɔ, e sa kaa e suɔ e nyɛmi hulɔ.
Kuasia! Ke o du ní ɔ, ja wu ɔ gbo ngɛ zu mi loko e maa puɛ.
Se benɛ i ná le kaa a so e yi nɔ nɛ a maa gbe lɛ ɔ,
E tsɔ nihi kɛ sɛ e hlami kɛ ya Samaria kɔpe ko mi, konɛ a ya dla he ko ngɔ to lɛ.
Yesaya de enɛ ɔ, ejakaa e na Yesu hɛ mi nyami ɔ ngɛ e hɛ mi lokoo, nɛ e tu he munyu.
Mɛnɔ ma nyɛ maa ye je ɔ nɔ kunimi? Ja nɔ nɛ heɔ yeɔ kaa Yesu ɔ, Mawu Bi ji lɛ.
I le nyɛ he sanehi babauu nɛ ma kɛ kojo nyɛ. Se nɔ nɛ tsɔ mi ɔ, anɔkualetsɛ ji lɛ, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ nɛ i nu kɛ je e nya a, lɔ ɔ i deɔ je ɔ.”
Yuda bi ɔmɛ bi lɛ ke, “Mo nɛ o na we jeha nyingmi enuɔ po ɔ, o na Abraham lo?”
Yuda ma nimeli ɔmɛ hla lɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ; nɛ a bi si ke, “Jije e ngɛ?”
Benɛ tsɔli ɔmɛ kpale a se kɛ ho asafoatsɛ ɔ we ɔ mi ya a, a ya na e nyɔguɛ ɔ nɛ e na he wami.
E he Lot hu yi wami. Lot nɛ ɔ, nɔmlɔ kpakpa ji lɛ, nɛ nihi nɛ bui mlaa a yakayaka je mi bami haoɔ lɛ wawɛɛ.
Yuda kɛ Tamar fɔ Perez, kɛ Zera; nɛ Perez fɔ Hezron, nɛ Hezron fɔ Ram.
Ke nɔ ko tuɔ munyu ngɛ lɛ nitsɛ e he wami nya a, e ngɛ hɛ mi nyami hlae ha e he. Se anɔkualetsɛ lɛɛ e hlaa kaa e maa wo nɔ nɛ tsɔ lɛ ɔ mohu hɛ mi nyami, nɛ sisimi be e mi.
Benɛ Yohane kaseli ɔmɛ ya sɛɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ha lɛ ɔ, e tsɛ a ti ni enyɔ,
Kɛkɛ nɛ Samaria yo ko ba nyu yɛmi. Yesu de lɛ ke, “Ha mi nyu ɔ eko nɛ ma nu.”
Ejakaa Mawu Bi ɔ, Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ tete nyɔmtsɛ ji lɛ.”
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, benɛ Yesu nu nɔ́ nɛ a ngɛ dee ngɛ e he ɔ, e je Yudea, nɛ e kpale e se kɛ ho Galilea ya.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ, kɛ Farisi bi ɔmɛ tsɔ Roma ta buli komɛ, kɛ sɔlemi we ɔ tsɔli komɛ abɔɔ ɔ mi, nɛ Yuda nyɛɛ a hɛ mi. A dla a he kaa nihi nɛ yaa ta, nɛ a hɛɛ kanehi, kɛ jatɛhi.
Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nɛ ha nyɛ suɔmi ɔ mi nɛ wa, konɛ nyɛɛ suɔ nyɛ sibi, kɛ nimli adesahi tsuo kaa bɔ nɛ wɔ hu wa suɔ nyɛ ɔ.
Farisi bi ɔmɛ kpale bi nyumu ɔ ekohu bɔ nɛ pee nɛ e na tsami ɔ. E de mɛ ke, “E pɔtɔ zu kɛ ha ye hɛngmɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ i ya fɔ ye he, kɛkɛ nɛ i bɔni nɔ hyɛmi.”

Nyɛ na nyɛɛ le kaa nihi nɛ fiɛɔ yo kɛ nyumu yakayaka fiɛmi, loo a tsuɔ mu ní, loo a hɛ kɔ̃ɔ̃ ɔ, a be blɔ nya ngɛ he nɛ Kristo kɛ Mawu ngɛ matsɛ yee ngɛ. (Ke nɔ ko kɛ hɛkɔ ngɛ nɔ́ ko se die ɔ, e ngɛ kaa wɔ jami pɛ).
Benɛ a kane Mose mlaa a, kɛ gbali ɔmɛ a womi ɔ se ɔ, kpe he ɔ nikɔtɔma amɛ tsɔ ba de Paulo kɛ Barnaba ke, “Nyɛmimɛ, ke nyɛ ngɛ munyu ko nɛ maa wo ni ɔmɛ he wami ɔ, nyɛɛ tu.”
Benɛ ma a tsuo ngɛ Yesu tue bue ɔ, e de e kaseli ɔmɛ ke,
Jehanɛ ɔ, Yesu wo e yi nɔ ekohu, nɛ e bi yo ɔ ke, “Maa, nihi nɛ ba po o nya a, jije a ngɛ? A ti nɔ kake po bui mo fɔ lo?”
Benɛ a ba lejɛ ɔ, a ba sɔle ha nihi nɛ he ye ɔ, konɛ a na Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ.
Nihi nɛ hɛɛ kikɛmɛ a tsɔɔmi nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, i wa mɛ yi mi, nɛ ni komɛ po gbo ngɛ mi. I nuɔ nyumuhi kɛ yihi tete kɛ ya woɔ tsu.
Ke a wo ye nɔ kɛ je zugba a nɔ ɔ, ma gbla nihi tsuo kɛ ba ye ngɔ.”
Mawu to kaa adesa nɛ gbo si kake, nɛ lɔ ɔ se ɔ, a kojo lɛ.
Imi Paulo nitsɛ, ye nine nya womi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Womi tsuaa womi nɛ ma ngma a, bɔ nɛ i gbeɔ nya ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Kikɛ nɛ ɔ i ngmaa womi. I biɔ nyɛ saminya.
Kekleekle nɛ i ya fa ye he ngɛ kojomi he ɔ, nɔ ko nɔ ko kɛ mi yɛ. Mɛ tsuo a si mi; Mawu kó gbla a tue ngɛ enɛ ɔ he.
Ejakaa nɔ́ nɛ je ɔ buu kaa nile ɔ ji kuasia nɔ́ ko ngɛ Mawu lɛɛ e hɛ mi. Ngmami ɔ ke, “Mawu ngɔɔ nile kɛ tsɔɔ ní leli klama.”
nɛ ke sane ko nɛ i bi hu, nyɛ be mi heto hae.
We tsuaa we mi nɛ nyɛ maa ya a, nyɛɛ hi lejɛ ɔ kɛ yaa si nyɛ maa je ma a mi.
Ko ka nyumu nɔkɔtɔma hɛ mi; se mohu tu munyu kɛ tsɔɔ lɛ kaa bɔ nɛ o kɛ o tsɛ maa tu munyu. Nihewi hu o kɛ mɛ nɛ hi si kaa bɔ nɛ o kɛ mo nitsɛ o nyɛminyumuhi maa hi si.

Paulo he nɔ ke, “Be ɔ kɛ jio, e kɛ́ we jio; i na nɛ jinɛ Mawu ha e ba mi kaa pi mo nɔ kake kɛkɛ, se mohu nihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ mi tue bue mwɔnɛ nɛ ɔ hu ko pee kaa bɔ nɛ i ngɛ nɛ ɔ; kɔsɔkɔsɔ nɛ ɔmɛ pɛ lɛ a ko wo mɛ!”
Nyɛ ha nɛ waa hɛɛ hemi kɛ yemi nɛ wa jajeɔ ɔ mi wawɛɛ. Ejakaa wa ngɛ osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa kpetekpleenyɛ nɛ po mi kɛ ho hiɔwe ya tɔɔ. Lɛ ji Yesu, Mawu Bi ɔ.
nyɛɛ ngɔ nyɛmi peemi ngɔ piɛ Mawu gbeye yemi ɔ he, nɛ nyɛɛ ngɔ suɔmi ngɔ piɛ nyɛmi peemi ɔ he.
Ni ɔmɛ a ti ni komɛ he ye kaa Paulo munyu ɔ ngɛ mi, nɛ a kɛ a he ya bɔ Paulo kɛ Sila a he. Hela bi Mawu gbeye yeli ɔmɛ a ti nihi babauu, kɛ yi komɛ nɛ a buu mɛ hu ya piɛ a he ja nɔuu.
Nihi babauu he e sɛ gbi ɔ ye, nɛ a sɔle mɛ. Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, a na nimli maa pee akpe etɛ kɛ piɛ a he.
Jehanɛ ɔ, Yesu ba Kapernaum ma a mi ngɛ Galilea, nɛ Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ, e ya kpe he ɔ ya tsɔɔ ní.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Farisi bi komɛ, kɛ mlaa tsɔɔli komɛ tu munyu huitihuiti kɛ si Yesu kaseli ɔmɛ ke, “Mɛni he je nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ tó tsuli, kɛ yayami peeli ngɛ ní yee, nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ mɛ ngɛ ní nue ɔ?”
ejakaa e suɔ wɔ Yuda bi ɔmɛ; wa kpe he ɔ po lɛ nɛ e ma ha wɔ.”
‘Se moo lɛɛ ma gbaa mo kɛ ní klɔuklɔuhi nɛ ngɛ daa kaa bɔ nɛ i wo David hu si ɔ.’
Kɛkɛ nɛ Mawu tu munyu kɛ je bɔku ɔ mi ke, “Ye Bi nɛ i hla ji nɛ ɔ nɛ; nyɛɛ bu lɛ tue!”
Nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ nɛ je Kaisarea a, a ti ni komɛ kɛ wɔ ho; nɛ a ha wa ya to Minason. Nyumu nɛ ɔ, Kipro no ji lɛ, nɛ e ba pee kaselɔ pi mwɔnɛ.
I heɔ yeɔ kaa nyɛ ma na maa le kaa wɔɔ lɛɛ a ka wɔ, nɛ wa je kpo kaa nihi nɛ sa niinɛ.
Se Yesu de mɛ ke, “Gbi nɛ ɔ, pi imi ye he nɛ e pɛ, nyɛ mohu nyɛ he.
Nyɛmimɛ nɛ i suɔ, enɛ ɔ ji womi enyɔne nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ ngmae. I bɔ mɔde ngɛ womi nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a mi kaa ma tsɛ nyɛ juɛmi se kɛ ba níhi nɛ nyɛ le momo ɔ a he.
Kɛkɛ nɛ e fa ke a sɔle ni ɔmɛ ngɛ Yesu Kristo biɛ mi. Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, a kpa Petro pɛɛ ke e kɛ mɛ nɛ hi si be bɔɔ ko.
Mawu ha wɔ mlaa kɛ gu Mose nɔ, se dloomi kɛ anɔkuale gu Yesu Kristo nɔ kɛ ba.
Nyɛ ya ngɔ na bi nɛ wo zɔ ɔ kɛ ba nɛ nyɛ ba gbe nɛ waa ye ní, nɛ wa na bua jɔmi.
Se bɔfo ɔ de lɛ ke, “Maria, koo ye gbeye; Mawu na o he bua jɔmi.
Kɛkɛ nɛ e de ke, “Nyɛɛ hyɛ, i na hiɔwe nya nɛ bli nɛ Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ daa si ngɛ Mawu hiɔ nɔ!”
Ye nyɛmimɛ, wa suɔ nɛ nyɛɛ le kaa Yesu nɔ nɛ a guu kɛ fiɛɔ tsɔɔ nyɛ ke, a maa ngɔ nyɛ he yayami kɛ pa nyɛ, nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ heɔ lɛ yeɔ ɔ maa ye e he; jinɛ Mose mlaa a nya a, a ko gbla e tue.
Nihi nɛ gbɛ fĩa a ya kpa si nɛ a fiɛ sane kpakpa a.
Nyɛ je nyɛ suɔmi kpo ngɔ tsɔɔ nyɛ sibi ngɛ nyɛ ní peemi mi kaa bɔ nɛ Kristo suɔ wɔ nɛ e ba gbo ngɛ wa he ɔ. Ee, Kristo ngɔ e he ngɔ ha kaa nike ní nɛ a kɛ sã bɔ, nɛ he via, nɛ sa Mawu hɛ mi.
Yo ko hu ngɛ Yopa nɛ ji Yesu se nyɛɛlɔ. A tsɛɛ lɛ Tabita, aloo ngɛ Hela gbi mi ɔ, Dorka. Biɛ nɛ ɔ sisi ji Odabɔ. Daa nɛ ɔ, kpakpa sɔuu e peeɔ, titli ɔ, e hyɛɔ dɛgutsɛmɛ a nɔ.
Mɛni ba loko Mawu bu wa nɛ̃ Abraham dalɔ ɔ? E ní tsumi ɔ nya! Ejakaa e ngɔ e bi Isak kɛ fɔ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ kaa e kɛ maa sã bɔ ha Mawu.
Kɛkɛ nɛ e ho nɛ e ya pɛtɛ daka a he, nɛ nihi nɛ hɛɛ daka a da si. Jehanɛ ɔ, Yesu de ke, “Niheyo, i ngɛ mo dee ke, tee si!”
Jehanɛ hu, nyɛ ko hɛɛ ní balɔ kotoku, loo hiɔwe tade enyɔ, loo tokota, loo dɛma tso tete; apaatsɛ ɔ, e nya ngma sa lɛ.
Nyɛ toɔ be titli komɛ, ligbi komɛ, nyɔhiɔ komɛ, kɛ jeha komɛ nɛ nyɛ kɛ peeɔ kusumi.
Nyagbe ɔ, nyɛ ha nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ he wami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ nɛ ngɛ nyɛ mi ɔ nɛ waje nyɛ.
E bi mɛ ke, “Ye bimɛ, nyɛ ná nɔ́ ko lo?”
Ke o pee o nyɛmi yayami kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ, Kristo nɛ o pee yayami kɛ si ɔ nɛ. Ejakaa mo lɛ o wo o nyɛmi ɔ he wami nɛ e kɛ pee nɔ́ ko nɛ e le kaa e sɛ nɛ e peeɔ.
Bɔfo ɔ de lɛ ke, “Kue nɛ o ngɛ fae, kɛ kpakpa nɛ o ngɛ pee ɔ, Mawu na he bua jɔmi.
Benɛ tsɔli ɔmɛ ba Yesu ngɔ ɔ, a de lɛ ke, “Yohane nɔ sɔlelɔ ɔ tsɔ wɔ ke wa ba bi mo ke, ‘Anɛ mo ji nɔ nɛ maa ba a, aloo waa hyɛ nɔ kpa blɔ?’ ”
Se Yesu he nɔ ke, “Maa, mɛni he je o ngɛ ye nya dooe? Be nɛ ma tsu ní ɔ sui lolo.”

Ke o ngɛ Mawu si nae ngɛ mumi mi kɛkɛ ɔ, nɔ ko nɛ hii si ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɛ lɛɛ e li mi eko ɔ, kɛ e maa pee kɛɛ nɛ e ma de “Amen” ngɔ si o sina sɔlemi ɔ nɔ? Blɔ ko blɔ ko be nɛ e kɛ maa le nɔ́ nɛ o ngɛ dee ɔ.
Niinɛ, sane kpakpa a nɛ wa ngɛ fiɛe ɔ, ni komɛ nui sisi; mɛ ji nihi nɛ a hɛ mi ngɛ kpatae ɔ nɛ.
Mohu ɔ, waa kɛ gbeye yemi nɛ hyɛ kojomi nɛ ma a, kɛ la gegeege nɛ ma kpata nihi nɛ teɔ si kɛ siɔ Mawu a hɛ mi ɔ blɔ.
lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yuda bi babauu ba Marta kɛ Maria a ngɔ, konɛ a ba ye mɛ kɔmɔ ngɛ a nyɛminyumu ɔ gbenɔ ɔ he.
Imi Paulo nitsɛ ye nine nya womi nɛ i ngma kaa i biɔ nyɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Nyɛ hɛ ko je nɔ kaa i ngɛ kɔsɔkɔsɔ mi kɛ mwɔɔ. Mawu dloomi ɔ kɛ nyɛ tsuo nɛ hi si.
“Ke o nyɛmi tɔ o nɔ ɔ, kã e hɛ mi, nɛ ke e pia e he ɔ, kɛ pa lɛ.
Pi Makedonia kɛ Akaya kɛkɛ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ sɛ gbi ɔ nɛ nyɛ fiɛ ɔ gbɛ fĩa a, se he tsuaa he ɔ, a nu nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ ngɛ Mawu mi ɔ hu he. Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, e hia we kaa wɔɔ wa deɔ nɔ́ ko hu.
Ejakaa munyu nɛ maa je nyɛ nya, kɛ juɛmi nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ ma fa nyɛ he ɔ, ma ha nyɛ. Nyɛ he nyɛli ɔmɛ a ti nɔ ko nɔ ko be nyɛ nyɛe, loo a maa je nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ dee ɔ he nɔ́.
Mawu nitsɛ pee okadi kɛ nyakpɛ ní slɔɔtohi babauu kɛ ye yi wami hemi nɛ ɔ he odase. Jehanɛ hu, e dla Mumi Klɔuklɔu nike ní ɔmɛ ngɔ ha kaa bɔ nɛ lɛ nitsɛ e suɔ kɛ ma nɔ mi.
Se Kristo ba kaa osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa kɛ ha blɔ nya tomi kpakpa nɛ wa na nɛ ɔ. Bo tsu nɛ e sɔmɔɔ ngɛ mi ɔ kle, nɛ e hi kɛ pi si. Pi adesa nɛ pee, nɛ tsɔɔ kaa pi je nɛ ɔ mi níhi nɛ a bɔ ɔ eko.
Nɔ nɛ peeɔ yayami lɛɛ Abosiami bi ji lɛ, ejakaa kɛ je sisije tɔɔ nɛ Abosiami bɔni yayami peemi. Enɛ ɔ he tutuutu nɛ Mawu Bi ɔ ba a nɛ, konɛ níhi nɛ Abosiami tsu ɔ, e ba kpata lɛ tsuo hɛ mi.
Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Yesu ya kpa mahi, kɛ kɔpehi a mi, nɛ e fiɛ sane kpakpa a nɛ kɔɔ Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ he ngɔ tsɔɔ nihi. Ni nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ piɛ e he,
Enɛ ɔ he ɔ, Abraham nɔ kake too nɛ ngɛ kaa nɔ ko nɛ yi ta a, e nina ba hiɛ babauu kaa dodoehi ngɛ hiɔwe, loo wo nya zia nɛ hi kanemi.
Yo ko ngɛ jamɛ a ma a mi nɛ yayami peelɔ ji lɛ. Benɛ e nu kaa Yesu ngɛ ní yee ngɛ Farisi no ɔ we ɔ mi ɔ, e hɛɛ tɛ kplu nɛ he jua wa kɛ e mi nu kɛ e he via kɛ ba.
Á gu Kristo Yesu nɔ kɛ wo Mawu hɛ mi nyami yi nɔhi tsuo ngɛ asafo ɔ mi kɛ ya neneene kɛ neneene. Amen.
Benɛ Yesu nu enɛ ɔ, e de lɛ ke, “E pa piɛ mo nɔ́ kake. Yaa jua níhi tsuo nɛ o ngɛ ɔ, nɛ o dla sika a ngɔ ha ohiatsɛmɛ, nɛ o ma na juetli ngɛ hiɔwe. Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, ba nɛ o ba nyɛɛ ye se.”

Nyɛ le bɔ nɛ a wa wɔ yi mi, nɛ a jɛ wɔ kɛ pue wa hɛ mi si ngɛ Filipi loko wa ba nyɛ ngɔ ngɛ Tesalonika a. E ngɛ mi kaa níhi fuu ka wɔ blɔ tsimi, se wa Mawu ɔ wo wɔ kã kaa wa ba fiɛ e sane kpakpa a ngɔ tsɔɔ nyɛ.
E ma ba kpata jamɛ a apaa yeli ɔmɛ a hɛ mi, nɛ e maa ngɔ wai ngmɔ ɔ kɛ ha ni kpahi.”
E kpale tsɔ nyɔguɛ etɛne; se lɛ hu apaa yeli ɔmɛ plaa lɛ, nɛ a tsitsɛɛ e yi se kɛ je kpo.
Koo ye esɔ kaa o maa ngɔ o nine kɛ pue nɔ ko nɔ kɛ wo lɛ asafo nɔkɔtɔma nɛ e tsu ní ha Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ. Ke nɔ ko ngɛ yayami pee ɔ, ko ya piɛ e he. Pee o he klɔuklɔu.
Ma a tsuo tu Yesu he munyu kusikusi. Benɛ ni komɛ de ke, “Nɔmlɔ kpakpa ji lɛ” ɔ, ni komɛ hu de ke, “Dɛbi, e ngɛ ma a nane tɔtɔe”.
Nyɛ ha nyɛ nya dali ɔmɛ nɛ a kɛ mi nɛ ya Kaisarea, nɛ ke sane yaya ko ngɛ nyumu ɔ he ɔ, a de ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.”
O ha nɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ wo wa nɛ̃ David, o tsɔlɔ ɔ he wami, nɛ e tu munyu ke,
Nimli babauu ɔ tsuo hla kaa a maa ta e he, ejakaa he wami ngɛ e mi jee kɛ ngɛ mɛ tsuo tsae.
Melea bi ɔ, Mena bi ɔ, Matata bi ɔ, Natan bi ɔ, David bi ɔ,
Niatsɛ ɔ he nɔ ke, ‘Tsaatsɛ Abraham, dɛbi; ye nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ be mɛ tue bue. Se ke nɔ ko je gbeje kɛ ya a ngɔ ɔ, lɔ ɔ loko a ma tsake a tsui.’
nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ ya kɔpe nɛ ngɛ nyɛ hɛ mi ɔ mi. Ke nyɛ su lejɛ ɔ, nyɛ maa na teji bi nɛ nɔ ko hí e nɔ hyɛ nɛ a muɔ lɛ si. Nyɛɛ pɛne lɛ, nɛ nyɛɛ ngɔ lɛ kɛ ba hiɛ ɔ.
Se e de mɛ ke, “E hia kaa ma ya fiɛ Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ he sane kpakpa a ngɛ ma kpa amɛ a mi hulɔ, ejakaa lɔ ɔ nɛ Mawu tsɔ mi ke ma ba tsu.”
Benɛ e ná ba su Roma pɛ nɛ e bɔni mi hlami hluu kɛ ya si e ba na mi.
“Se Hepiɛlɔ ɔ maa ba. Lɛ ji Mumi ɔ nɛ haa a leɔ anɔkuale nɛ kɔɔ Mawu he ɔ nɛ. Ma tsɔ lɛ kɛ je Tsɛ ɔ ngɔ kɛ ba nyɛ ngɔ, nɛ e ma ba ye ye he odase.
Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, gbi nɛ Mawu wo ɔ ha nɛ zugba a mimiɛ; se jehanɛ lɛɛ e wo si ke, “Pi zugba a kɛkɛ nɛ ma mimiɛ si kake ekohu, se mohu ma ha nɛ hiɔwe hu ma mimiɛ kɛ piɛ he.”
Ngmami ɔ ke, “Mawu ngɔ níhi tsuo ngɔ wo e nane si.” Se e fɔɔ si paa kaa munyu “níhi tsuo” ɔ tsɔɔ we kaa lɛ Mawu ɔ nitsɛ nɛ e ngɔ níhi tsuo ngɔ wo Kristo nane si ɔ hu piɛ he.
Mawu dloo mi nike ní pɔtɛɛ ko kaa sane kpakpa a fiɛlɔ, nɛ ma kɛ sɔmɔ lɛ. E he wami ɔ nɛ e kɛ tsu nɔ́ nɛ ɔ.
Jehanɛ ɔ, ke kaa Mawu pee adesa níhi tsuo a nɔ yelɔ, lɛɛ nɔ́ ko be nɛ adesa be he wami ngɛ nɔ. Anɔkuale mi ɔ, wa nɛ́ kaa adesa ngɛ tsɛ yee ngɛ níhi tsuo a nɔ amlɔ nɛ ɔ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ma suɔ mohu kaa yalɔyihi nɛ wɛ lolo ɔ, a gba nɛ a fɔ bimɛ; nɛ a hyɛ a we nɔ saminya, konɛ wa he nyɛli ko na he blɔ ko kulaa kɛ tu munyu yaya kɛ si wɔ.
Nyɛ juɛmi mi kuɔ we kulaa! Anɛ nɔ ko ngɛ hiɛ ɔ nɛ heɔ e he yeɔ kaa Kristo nɔ́ ji lɛ lo? Saminya! Jamɛ a nɔ ɔ nɛ susu e yi mi ekohu; ejakaa wɔ hu Kristo níhi ji wɔ kaa lɛ nɔuu.
Nɔ nɛ a ngɛ lɛ ní tsɔɔe ɔ, kɛ e tsɔɔlɔ ɔ nɛ dla ní kpakpahi nɛ e ngɛ ɔ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ nɛ susuɔ kaa e daa si ɔ, e hyɛ e he nɛ hi, konɛ e ko nɔ si.
“Wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ bui lɛ, mohu a hɛɛ lɛ soisoi, nɛ a hla kaa a maa kpale a se kɛ ho Egipt ya ekohu.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ kɛ ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ tsuo nyɛ ma yɔse suɔmi nɛ Kristo ngɛ kɛ ha nyɛ ɔ mi blimi, e kami, kɛ e mi kuɔmi.
ejakaa Tsɛ ɔ nitsɛ ngɛ nyɛ he suɔmi. Tsɛ ɔ suɔ nyɛ, ejakaa nyɛ suɔ mi, nɛ nyɛ he ye kaa Mawu ngɔ nɛ i je kɛ ba.
Se Toma de mɛ ke, “Ja i na e dɛ mi plɛɛko pa amɛ nɛ i kɛ ye nine nguɛ slaa a nya, nɛ i ngɔ ye nine hɔ e kasa mi ɔ hulɔ loko ma he ye.”
Tsɔlɔ ɔ, e hia we lɛ sina kaa e pee nɔ́ nɛ a fa lɛ ke e pee ɔ.
Ke nɔ ko suɔ kaa ma nɛ le lɛ saminya a, níhi nɛ e peeɔ ɔ, e laa we nɔ. Ní ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ o ngɛ pee ɔ, ha nɛ je ɔ tsuo nɛ nu he.”
Nyɛ kase Mawu dloomi sane nɛ ɔ kɛ je wa suɔlɔ Epafra nɛ waa kɛ lɛ ngɛ ní tsumi kake tsue ɔ nya. Lɛ hu Kristo sɔmɔlɔ anɔkualetsɛ ji lɛ; nɛ e ngɛ ní tsue ha wɔ.
Nyɛ kai munyuhi nɛ gbali klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ tu blema lokoo ɔ, kɛ wa Nyɔmtsɛ kɛ wa kpɔlɔ ɔ mlaa nɛ bɔfo ɔmɛ nɛ a tsɔ mɛ nyɛ ngɔ ɔ kɛ ba ha nyɛ ɔ.
Nyɛɛ kɛ Mawu ji wa we odase kaa wa ba wa je mi saminya ngɛ nyɛ nihi nɛ nyɛ heɔ yeɔ ɔ nyɛ kpɛti. Wa peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da blɔ nɛ piami ko be wa he.
Se nyɔ mi benɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ hwɔ si ɔ, he nyɛlɔ ko ba du hu kɛ futu ngma a, nɛ e je.
Jã nɔuu lakpa tsɔɔli nɛ ɔmɛ hu bleɔ he lo ɔ; a teɔ si kɛ siɔ Mawu nɔ yemi ɔ, nɛ a jɛɔ ni klɔuklɔuhi nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ po.
Samaria bi babauu nɛ ngɛ jamɛ a ma a mi ɔ he Yesu ye, ejakaa yo ɔ de mɛ ke, “E de mi níhi tsuo nɛ i pee.”
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ kpa yayami tsuaa yayami peemi, lakpa, osato, ninyɛ, kɛ nihi a he munyu tumi.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ nyɛɔ mi ɔ, e nyɛɔ Tsaatsɛ hulɔ.
Amlɔ ɔ, nyumu ɔ te si ngɛ ni ɔmɛ tsuo a hɛ mi; e ngɔ sa a nɛ e hwɔ nɔ ɔ, nɛ e je kɛ ho we mi ya. Benɛ e yaa a tsuo e ngɛ Mawu yi jee.
Benɛ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ nu he ɔ, a kɛ Saulo ya Kaisarea, nɛ a wo lɛ blɔ kɛ ho Tarso ya.
Nyɛ gba puɛli nɛ nyɛ yi Mawu anɔkuale! Anɛ nyɛ li kaa ke nɔ ko suɔ je ɔ, nɔ ɔ ngɛ Mawu nyɛe lo? Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ e kɛ je ɔ bɔɔ ɔ, e peeɔ Mawu he nyɛlɔ.
I de nyɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ, konɛ nyɛɛ kɛ mi nɛ hi si, konɛ nyɛ na he jɔmi. Benɛ nyɛ ngɛ je ɔ mi ɔ, haomi maa ba nyɛ nɔ; se nyɛ tsui nɛ nɔ nyɛ mi, ejakaa i ye je ɔ nɔ kunimi.”
Se Petro de lɛ ke, “I be sika hiɔ, loo sika tsu, se nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ ɔ, lɔ ɔ i ngɛ mo hae nɛ ɔ nɛ. Ngɛ Yesu Kristo, Nazaret no ɔ biɛ mi ɔ, tee si nɛ o nyɛɛ!”
Kɛkɛ nɛ Yesu bi ke, “Pi nyumuhi nyɔngma nɛ i tsa a? Jije nɛɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ?
Ejakaa Mawu suɔ je ɔ saminya, nɛ e ngɔ e Bi kake ɔ ngɔ ha, konɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ heɔ lɛ yeɔ ɔ, e hɛ mi ko kpata, se mohu e na neneene wami.
Yuda ma nimeli ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ Yerusalem ɔ tsɔ osɔfo komɛ, kɛ Levi bi komɛ Yohane ngɔ. A ba bi lɛ ke, “Mɛnɔ ji mo?”

Ke nɔ́ ko ngɛ nɛ a ngɛ hlae nɛ a le ɔ, a bi a hunomɛ ngɛ we mi. Ke asafo ɔ ba bua nɛ a ngɛ Mawu jae ɔ, e ji zo kaa yo maa tu munyu.
Kɛkɛ nɛ nɔ ko ba de mɛ ke, “Nyɛ le nɔ́ ko! Ni ɔmɛ nɛ nyɛ nuu wo tsu ɔ, a daa si ngɛ ma a ní tsɔɔe ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ.”
Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ji mumi ɔ nɛ, nɛ he nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mumi ɔ ngɛ ɔ, lejɛ ɔ he yemi ngɛ.
Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, a wo Yohane nɔ sɔlelɔ ɔ tsu. Benɛ Yohane nu níhi nɛ Kristo ngɛ tsue ɔ a he ngɛ tsu ɔ mi ɔ, e tsɔ e kaseli ɔmɛ ekomɛ kɛ sɛ gbi nɛ ɔ ba ha Yesu
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ma ha nɛ a fia lɛ kpa, nɛ ma ngmɛɛ e he.”
Yesu de lɛ ke, “Ba!” Kɛkɛ nɛ Petro je lɛ ɔ mi, nɛ e nyɛɛ nyu ɔ hɛ mi kɛ yaa Yesu ngɔ.
Be tsuaa be ɔ, nyɛɛ na Tsɛ Mawu si ngɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ he.
Ye nyɛmimɛ, i suɔ kaa ma ha nyɛ nɔ hyɛmi nɔ́ ko kɛ je wa je mi si himi mi. Ke ni enyɔ ma nɔ́ ko nya si, nɛ a pee womi ngɔ fɔ nɔ ɔ, nɔ ko nɔ ko be nyɛe maa po mi, loo e maa ngɔ nɔ́ kpa ko ngɔ piɛ he.
Lɛɛ wa ma de ke kɛ gu Abraham nɔ ɔ, a he mi dlami nyɔngma mi kake ɔ ngɛ Levi nɛ jinɛ lɛ nɛ heɔ mi dlami nyɔngmanyɔngma mi kakaaka a hu e dɛ.
Ní nɛ i ngɛ tsue ɔ, imi nitsɛ nɛ i suɔ kaa ma tsu jinɛ i ko hyɛ hiɔwo blɔ. Se Mawu nitsɛ nɛ hla mi, nɛ e ngɔ ní tsumi ɔ ngɔ wo ye dɛ kaa nɔmlɔ nɛ yeɔ anɔkuale.
Jehanɛ, kaseli ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ lɛ ɔ mi ɔ ja Yesu, nɛ a de ke, “Niinɛ, Mawu Bi ji mo!”
Sɔmɔli yi ɔmɛ hu ja nɔuu a pee nihi nɛ tsuɔ ní kɛ hɛdɔ, nɛ a ko ye sieku. A pee nihi nɛ a hɛ ka si, nɛ a yeɔ anɔkuale ngɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ mi.
Lɛ kpa komɛ je Tiberia ba sa kpo he he nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ na Mawu si, nɛ ma kpekpemi ɔ ye abolo ɔ ngɛ ɔ.
Be saii mi ɔ, wai nɛ a ngɛ nue ɔ ta; nɛ Yesu nyɛ ba e ngɔ ba de lɛ ke, “Ni ɔmɛ a wai ɔ ta.”
E ngɛ kaa bɔ nɛ a ma tle ni gbogboehi si kɛ ba wami mi ekohu ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ. Nɔ́ nɛ a pu kaa wu ɔ ma puɛ, se nɔ́ nɛ a ma tle si ɔ lɛɛ e be puɛe.
Ke nyɛ nya ba bua a, pi Nyɔmtsɛ niye ní ɔ nɛ nyɛ yeɔ.
Wa heɔ adesa we odase yeɔ, se Mawu we odase ɔ mi jiɔ kulaa pe adesa nɔ́. Nɛ Mawu ɔ nitsɛ lɛ ye odase nɛ ɔ ngɛ e Bi ɔ he.
Yesu he nɔ ke, “He nɛ i yaa a, amlɔ nɛ ɔ lɛɛ o be ye se nyɛe maa nyɛɛ; se pee se ɔ, o ma ba nyɛɛ ye se.”
I kpaa pɛɛ nɛ nyɛ he ye, nɛ Kristo nɛ hi nyɛ tsui mi, konɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ pee ɔ, nyɛɛ pee kɛ suɔmi nɛ mi wa.
Se Petro te si, nɛ e sa fo kɛ ya yɔkɔ ɔ he. E kɔkɔ e yi si, nɛ e na kploba amɛ nɛ pueɔ si. Nɔ́ nɛ ba a pee lɛ nyakpɛ saminya; kɛkɛ nɛ e kpale kɛ ho we mi ya.]
Pilato de mɛ ke, “Nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛɛ ngɔ lɛ nɛ nyɛ ya sɛu mɔ; ejakaa imi lɛɛ i nɛ sane yobu ko ngɛ e he nɛ ma da nɔ kɛ bu lɛ fɔ.”
“Ye Bi ji mo,
Nɛ wɔ nɛ a bɔ wɔ ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi no ɔ subai nɔ ɔ, wa ma ba hɛɛ Hiɔwe No ɔ subai.
E ngɛ mi niinɛ kaa “wɔ tsuo wa le ní,” kaa bɔ nɛ a deɔ ɔ. Se nile haa nɔ woɔ e he nɔ, nɛ suɔmi lɛɛ e woɔ nɔ he wami.
Nɔmlɔ kpakpa jeɔ ní kpakpahi kɛ jeɔ e juetli kpakpahi a mi; nɔmlɔ yayami hu jeɔ ní yayahi kɛ jeɔ e juetli yayahi a mi.
Ní nɛmɛ nɛ wa naa daa nɛ ɔ lɛɛ e hia we kaa a pee mɛ jã. Nɛ́ Mawu pee nɔmlɔ tso ɔ, e he ní komɛ nɛ wa susuɔ kaa a he be se nami tsɔ ko ɔ, lɔ ɔmɛ mohu a hɛ mi nyami nɛ e wo pe kulaa.
Blɔ bli ha mi ngɛ hiɛ ɔ nɛ ma tsu ní saminya, se kɛ̃ ɔ, nihi nɛ teɔ si woɔ mi ɔ, mɛ hu a ngɛ hiɛ ɔ babauu.
Nyɛ je nyɛ suɔmi kpo kɛ tsɔɔ wɔ! Wa pee we nɔ ko yayami; wa kpataa we nɔ ko nane, nɛ wa sisi we nɔ ko hulɔ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e de e ngmɔ nɔ hyɛlɔ ɔ ke, ‘Hyɛ, jeha etɛ sɔuu ji nɛ ɔ nɛ i baa ba hlaa yiblii ngɛ ngmɔkɔ tso nɛ ɔ nɔ, se i nɛ eko. Poo tso ɔ ngɔ fɔ si! Mɛni he je nɛ e maa hi zugba a puɛe kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ?’
Ke nyɛ suɔ nyɛ sibi ɔ, kɛkɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ maa le kaa ye kaseli ji nyɛ.”
Jehanɛ Agripa de Paulo ke, “A ngmɛ mo blɔ, mo je o nya!” Kɛkɛ nɛ Paulo fɔ e nine, nɛ e fa e he ke,
Jamɛ a be ɔ, wa ma nyɛ maa fiɛ sane kpakpa a ngɛ ma kpahi a nɔ ngɛ Korinto se je lokoo. Kɛkɛ ɔ, he ko nɛ nɔ ko ya tsu ní ngɛ momo ɔ, wɔɔ wa be yae, konɛ wɔ mohu wa ko ba na yi jemi.
A kɛ niheyo ɔ ho we mi ya hɛ ngmengmle; nɛ a bua jɔ a he saminya.
Anɔkuale mi ɔ, pi wa kpɛti nɛ nimli nɛ ɔmɛ je; nɛ lɔ ɔ he je nɛ a si wɔ ɔ nɛ. Kaa wa kpɛti nɛ a je jinɛ a kɛ wɔ ko hi si. Se a si wɔ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ e fɔ si paa kaa a ti nɔ ko nɔ ko kɛ wɔ bɔɛ.
Yo ɔ de ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, e ngɛ mi ja mohu, se tse gbe ɔmɛ hu yeɔ bibliwi nɛ jeɔ a nyɔmtsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a we okplɔɔ nɔ pueɔ si ɔ eko!”
Ke wa gbɔjɔ, nɛ nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ ngɛ he wami ɔ, wa naa bua jɔmi. Enɛ ɔ he je nɛ wa ngɛ Mawu pɛɛ kpae ha nyɛ ɔ nɛ, konɛ nyɛɛ ya nɔ nɛ nyɛɛ hi kɛ pi si.
I ngɔ lɛ kɛ ba o kaseli ɔmɛ a ngɔ, se a nyɛ we nɛ a tsa lɛ.”
Benɛ a na dodoe ɔ, a na bua jɔmi wawɛɛ nitsɛ.
Mohu ɔ, a na paa kaa ní tsumi pɔtɛɛ nɛ Mawu ha mi ji kaa ma fiɛ sane kpakpa a ha ma je li kaa bɔ nɛ a hla Petro kaa e fiɛ sane kpakpa a ha Yuda bi ɔ.
Jehanɛ, e je e nine ngɔ tsɔɔ e kaseli ɔmɛ, nɛ e de ke, “Hyɛ, maa, kɛ ye nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ ji nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ nɛ.
nihi nɛ tsɛɔ a he Mawu jali, se anɔkuale mi ɔ, a bui e mi he wami ɔ kulaa. Nimli kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ, yu o he kɛ je a he.

Benɛ Kristo gu bo tsu ɔ mi kɛ ya sɛ he klɔuklɔu pe kulaa a, e pee nɔ́ nɛ ɔ si kake nyɔngloo. Pi to, loo na muɔ nɛ e kɛ sã bɔ ɔ; mohu ɔ, e ngɔ lɛ nitsɛ e muɔ ngɔ ha, konɛ e kɛ he wa yi wami kɛ ya neneene.
I ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, gbali, kɛ matsɛmɛ fuu hla kaa a ko na níhi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ hyɛe nɛ ɔ, se a nɛ; a hla kaa a ko nu níhi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ nue nɛ ɔ, se a nui.”
Benɛ Yesu si ma kpekpemi ɔ, nɛ e ba we mi ɔ, e kaseli ɔmɛ ba e ngɔ ba de lɛ ke, “Abɛ ɔ nɛ kɔɔ hu ɔ nɛ ngɛ ngmɔ ɔ mi ɔ he ɔ, tsɔɔ wɔ sisi.”
E kɛ ní tsuli ɔmɛ ye nya kaa e ma ha nɔ tsuaa nɔ sika hiɔ yi kake nɛ ji apaatsɛ ligbi kake hiɔwo ɔ. Kɛkɛ nɛ e wo mɛ blɔ kɛ ho e wai ngmɔ ɔ mi ya.
Sɔlemi kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ hi, nɛ e saa Mawu, wa kpɔlɔ ɔ hɛ mi.
Benɛ waa kɛ nyɛ ngɛ ɔ, wa wo nyɛ mlaa nɛ ɔ ke, “Ke nɔ ko sume kaa e ma tsu ní ɔ, e ko ye ní.”
Benɛ ngma a ba wa nɛ e wo yiblii ɔ, hu ɔ hu yi je kpo.
(Nɔ ko nyɛ́ lɛ nitsɛ e he lo, se mohu e lɛɛ e nɔmlɔ tso ɔ, nɛ e baa e yi saminya kaa bɔ nɛ Kristo hu hyɛɛ asafo ɔ.
A wo nihi nɛ he ye ɔ he wami, konɛ a hemi kɛ yemi mi nɛ wa. A tsɔɔ mɛ hulɔ kaa, “E sa kaa waa gblee amanehlu babauu mi kɛ sɛ Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ mi.”
Se Petro kɛ Yohane hyɛ lɛ too; nɛ Petro de lɛ ke, “Hyɛ wa hɛ mi!”
Nyɛɛ sɔle ha wɔ daa. Wa le kaa wa he nile bui wɔ fɔ; ejakaa be tsuaa be ɔ, wa suɔ kaa nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ wa maa pee ɔ, bu nɛ hi he.
(Níhi nɛ nihi peeɔ ngɛ laami mi ɔ ngɛ zo tsɔ kaa a maa wo ta tete).
Ni komɛ ba de Yesu ke, “Yohane kaseli ɔmɛ pɔɔ hwɔ hami kɛ sɔlemi, nɛ Farisi bi ɔmɛ a kaseli ɔmɛ hu peeɔ ja nɔuu; se moo lɛɛ o kaseli ɔmɛ yeɔ ní, nɛ a nuɔ ní.”
Tse nyɛ na nɔ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ pee ɔ! Mi gbami nyɛɛ kɛ ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti bae ɔ nɛ. Nyɛ ngɛ nyɛ sibi a he ga yaya toe.
Benɛ kpe ngua a mi bi ɔmɛ na kã nɛ Petro kɛ Yohane pee, nɛ a ná le hu kaa nimli gu kɛkɛ ji mɛ, se pi womi mi leli ɔ, a he mi po. A kɔ se kaa a kɛ Yesu hi si.
A maa pee a he lakpatsɛmɛ, kɛ nɔ sisili nɛ a he nile gbo pɛsɛpɛsɛ.
Ejakaa nyɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ la bimɛ ji nyɛ; ee, piani bimɛ ji nyɛ; wa pi nyɔ, loo diblii bimɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ni wawi, kɛ ni nguahi tsuo buɔ lɛ, nɛ a deɔ ke, “Nɔmlɔ nɛ ɔ hɛɛ Mawu a he wami nɛ tsɛɛ kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ.”
“Nɔ́ nɛ ma de nyɛ nɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ bu tue saminya! A maa ngɔ Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ kɛ wo nihi nɛ he wa a dɛ mi.”
Anɔkuale munyu ji nɛ ɔ nɛ, ejakaa níhi tsuo nɛ i de ɔ, pi imi nitsɛ ye yi mi nɛ i to kɛ de ekoeko. Tsɛ ɔ nɛ tsɔ mi ɔ lɛ fa ke ma de.
Yesu ya nɔ nɛ e de ke, “Nyumu ko hi si, nɛ e ngɛ binyumuhi enyɔ.
Anɛ o ngɛ hlae nɛ o gbe mi kaa bɔ nɛ o gbe jamɛ a Egipt no ɔ hiɛ ɔ?’
e he jua wa ha nyɛ saminya;
Daa nyɔ kɛ pia a, wa kpaa lɛ pɛɛ kɛ wa tsui tsuo kaa waa na nyɛ hɛ mi kɛ hɛ mi, konɛ waa wo nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ mi he wami.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Farisi bi komɛ nɛ ngɛ ni ɔmɛ a kpɛti ɔ de Yesu ke, “Tsɔɔlɔ, ha nɛ o se nyɛɛli ɔmɛ nɛ a pee dii!”
Yesu de mɛ ke, “Be nɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ maa ba mi ɔ, Tsaatsɛ pɛ lɛ to, nɛ e pi nyɛ blɔ nya kaa nyɛ maa le;
Ye bimɛ tsɔwi, nyɛɛ ya nɔ nɛ nyɛɛ hi Kristo mi, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ ke e je e he kpo ɔ, wa nɔ gbagba nɛ te. Kɛkɛ ɔ, ligbi ɔ nɛ e maa ba a, zo be wɔ gbee ngɛ e hɛ mi.
Jehanɛ kpe ɔ tsuo pee dii, konɛ a bu Barnaba kɛ Paulo tue. A bɔ kpe ɔ bɔ nɛ Mawu gu a nɔ kɛ tsu nyakpɛ níhi babauu ngɛ ma je li ɔmɛ a kpɛti.
Salmon kɛ Rahab fɔ Boaz, nɛ Boaz kɛ Rut fɔ Obed, nɛ Obed fɔ Ishai.
Enɛ ɔ tsɔɔ kaa nɔ́ ko nɛ a deɔ ke, ‘Nɔ ko duɔ ní, nɛ nɔ ko hu kpaa’ a ngɛ mi niinɛ.
Osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa a nitsɛ ɔ, sé ngɛ e he. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e taa bua si ha nihi nɛ li nɔ́ ko mi, kɛ nihi nɛ tlaa blɔ ɔ.
ni enyɔ kɛ ba e ngɔ, nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Nyɛ hla ta buli
