Maria kɛ munyu nɛ ɔmɛ to e yi mi, nɛ e susuɔ he be tsuaa be.
Moo lɛɛ o le Yuda bi ɔmɛ a kusumihi tsuo, kɛ slɔɔto nɛ ngɛ a kpɛti ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i kpa mo pɛɛ nɛ o to tsui si, nɛ o bu mi tue.
Asafo nya dalɔ ɔ, sé kó hi e he. É hi yo kake; é le e he nɔ hyɛmi; e hɛ mi nɛ ka si, nɛ bu nɛ hi e he. É le nubwɔ peemi, nɛ e nyɛ nɛ e tsɔɔ ní hulɔ.
Benɛ i ya Yerusalem ɔ, Yuda osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ, kɛ ma nimeli ɔmɛ ba ye ngɔ ba po e nya, nɛ a kpa mi pɛɛ ke ma bu lɛ fɔ.
Se benɛ a bli a hɛngmɛ ɔ, a nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko ngɛ lejɛ ɔ kaa ja Yesu nɔ kake pɛ.
Nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ heɔ jokuɛyo kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ ngɛ ye biɛ mi ɔ, imi e he ɔ nɛ.
ke a nane ma lejɛ ɔ fii!’ ”
E ma fɔ binyumu, nɛ o maa wo lɛ biɛ ke Yesu, ejakaa e ma he e ma a yi wami kɛ je a he yayami ɔmɛ a mi.”
Benɛ Yesu ngɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ kɛ yaa Yerusalem ɔ, e ya gu huza a nɔ ngɛ Samaria kɛ Galilea a kpɛti.
Kɛkɛ nɛ glɔtsɛ ɔ hyɛ mɛ gaa, nɛ e hyɛ blɔ kaa e ma ná nɔ́ ko kɛ je a dɛ.
Ejakaa nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ le tsɔ kaa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ maa ba tlukaa kaa bɔ nɛ julɔ baa nyɔ mi.
Wa ngɛ mɔde bɔe nɛ wa ko pee nɔ́ ko nɛ ma ha nihi maa tu munyu yaya ngɛ nike ní nguaa nɛ ɔ nɔ hyɛmi he.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ji Mawu bi ɔ, e yɛ nɔ nɛ e hii yayami pee, ejakaa e hɛɛ Mawu su nitsɛnitsɛ. Nɛ akɛnɛ Mawu bi ji lɛ he je ɔ, e be nyɛe maa pee yayami.
nɛ e bi mɛ ke, “Mɛnɔ ofoni ji nɛ ɔ, nɛ mɛnɔ biɛ a ngma ngɛ nɔ ɔ?”
Nɔ́ nɛ fɔɔ si paa ji, wa ní tsumi ɔ he guɛ ma gbo. Pi lɔ ɔ kɛkɛ, se mohu a maa ye yo mawu Artemi jami he ɔ he fɛu, nɛ bɔ nɛ a nyaa e he ngɛ Asia, kɛ je ɔ mi tsuo ɔ se maa po!”
Lɛɛ ke e maa hi ɔ, waa pee nihi tsuo kpakpa daa, titli ɔ, nihi nɛ waa kɛ mɛ hɛɛ hemi kɛ yemi kake ɔ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yesu nyɛɛ we ngɛ Yuda bi ɔmɛ a kpɛti nɛ a na lɛ paa hu. Se e je kɛ ho nga a nɔ ya, nɛ e kɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ ya hi ma ko nɛ a tsɛɛ Efraim ɔ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ ná nyɛɛ le kaa nihi nɛ heɔ Mawu yeɔ ɔ, mɛ ji Abraham nina.
Kikɛmɛ a nile nɛ ɔ, pi hiɔwe nɛ e je; zugba nɛ ɔ nɔ nɔ́; Mawu mumi be mi, mumi yayami sɔuu.
Tsɔsemi nɛ a haa nihi tsuo ɔ, ke nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ na we ɔ, lɛɛ ajuama mi bimɛ ji nyɛ, nɛ nyɛ pi e bimɛ nitsɛnitsɛmɛ.
Ejakaa nɔ nɛ tsuɔ nihi a he, kɛ ni nɛmɛ e tsu a he ɔ tsuo a tsɛ kake. Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, e pee we Yesu zo kaa e ma tsɛ mɛ nyɛmimɛ.
Jehanɛ Roma kojoli ɔmɛ hía tade ɔmɛ ngɛ Paulo kɛ Sila a he, nɛ a fa ke a fia mɛ kpa.
e wo nyɛ bua, nɛ e ha nyɛ he wami nɛ nyɛ tsu ní kpakpa, nɛ nyɛɛ tu munyu kpakpa daa.
Se Yesu de lɛ ke, “Blɔɔ ke nyɛ nɛ okadihi, kɛ nyakpɛ níhi ɔ, lɛɛ nyɛ be hee maa ye!”

Lɛɛ jehanɛ ɔ, mɛni ji mlaa a he se nami mɔ? A ha wɔ mlaa a, konɛ wa kɛ le wa tɔmi ɔmɛ hluu kɛ yaa su be nɛ Abraham bi ɔ nɛ a wo lɛ si ngɛ he ɔ maa ba. Jehanɛ hu, hiɔwe bɔfohi lɛ ngɔ mlaa a kɛ ba ha je ɔ kɛ gu adesa nɔ.
Mɛni ji nɔ́ nɛ i pee ha asafo kpa amɛ nɛ i pee we ha nyɛ, pe kaa i doo we nyɛ nya ke nyɛɛ ye kɛ bua mi kɛ nɔ́ ko? Ke enɛ ɔ ji yayami nɛ i pee nyɛ ɔ, i kpa nyɛ pɛɛ nɛ nyɛ ngɔ pa mi!
E nɔ jena a, wa ya su Sidon. Yulio hɛɛ Paulo saminya; e ngmɛ lɛ blɔ nɛ e ya slaa e huɛmɛ, nɛ a ha lɛ níhi nɛ hia lɛ.
Wa huɛmɛ nɛ wa suɔ, ke wa ngɛ munyu tue kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ po, nyɛɛ lɛɛ wa heɔ nyɛ yeɔ kaa nyɛ ngɛ nɔ́ kpakpa pee, nɛ lɔ ɔ ma ha nɛ Mawu ma he nyɛ yi wami.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Kristo ba nɛ e ba fiɛ sane kpakpa a nɛ haa nɔ he jɔmi ɔ ngɔ tsɔɔ nihi tsuo. E fiɛ ngɔ tsɔɔ nyɛ ma je li nɛ sa a nyɛɛ kɛ Mawu kpɛti kɛ ɔ, kɛ Yuda bi nɛ mɛɛ lɛɛ a ngɛ e kasa nya haa a.
Yesu he nɔ ke, “Niinɛ, Eliya ma, nɛ e ma ba to níhi tsuo blɔ nɔ ekohu.
Anɛ wa mlaa a ngmɛɛ blɔ kaa a tsu tó ha Kaisare ɔ, loo a ko tsu?”
Nyɛɛ ba nyɛ he si; nyɛɛ pee nyɛ he humi, nɛ nyɛɛ to nyɛ tsui si. Nyɛɛ na ha nyɛ sibi nɛ nyɛ kɛ tsɔɔ kaa nyɛ suɔ nyɛ he niinɛ.
Benɛ nihi nɛ ngɛ kpotoo ɔmɛ hyɛe ɔ na nɔ́ nɛ ba a, a tu fo nɛ a ya sɛɛ ngɛ ma a mi, kɛ kɔpe ɔmɛ a mi,
Se kɛ ngmami ɔ deɔ kɛɛ? E deɔ ke, “Wo yo nyɔguɛ ɔ kɛ e bi ɔ blɔ nɛ a ho, ejakaa yo nyɔguɛ ɔ bi ɔ be he blɔ nɛ e kɛ yo odehe ɔ bi ɔ yeɔ gbosi ní.”
Yesu de hu ke, “Mɛni he ma ngɔ Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ ngɔ to?
se mohu, gbenɔ nɛ Kristo gbo, nɛ e ngɔ e he kɛ sã bɔ nɛ he jua wa a. Ee, Kristo ngɛ kaa to bi nɛ kpa, aloo mu ko be e he.
Be mi nɛ a ngɛ tsopa kɛ e he via a sãe ɔ, ma kpekpemi ɔ ngɛ sɔlee ngɛ ablanaa a mi.
Ejakaa nyɛ ngɛ kaa nihi nɛ gbo, nɛ a ngɔ nyɛ wami ɔ kɛ Kristo tsuo ngɔ laa ngɛ Mawu mi.
O wo ye hɛ mi nyami, nɛ i ha mɛ hu a hɛ mi ba nyami ja nɔuu, konɛ a pee kake kaa bɔ nɛ i kɛ mo ngɛ ɔ.

Laami sane ɔ ji kaa sane kpakpa a he ɔ, gbaami nɛ Mawu gbaa Yuda bi ɔmɛ ɔ, ma je li ɔmɛ hu ba na eko. Mɛ tsuo a ba pee kaa nɔmlɔ tso kake ɔ he níhi; nɛ si nɛ Mawu wo kɛ gu Kristo Yesu nɔ ɔ, a ná mɛ hu a blɔ nya nɔ.
Ejakaa Yohane ɔ he lɛ a ngma ngɛ ke, ‘Hyɛ, i ngɛ ye tsɔlɔ ɔ tsɔe kɛ sɛ o hlami, nɛ e ya dla o blɔ ɔ ngɔ to mo.’
Je ɔ be nyɛ nyɛe, se a nyɛɔ mi, ejakaa a yeɔ odase kɛ siɔ mɛ ngɛ ní yayamihi nɛ a peeɔ ɔ he.
Benɛ niheyo ɔ nu nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, e kɛ aywilɛho je lejɛ ɔ; ejakaa e ngɛ ní babauu.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Petro, i ngɛ mo dee ke tɛ sa ji mo, nɛ kikɛmɛ a tɛ sa nɛ ɔ nɔ ma ma ye asafo ɔ ngɛ. Nɛ gbenɔ tete po be nyɛe maa ye e nɔ.
Mawu pee Yuda bi, kɛ nyɛ ma je li tsuo kake. Enɛ ɔ he ɔ, a wo imi Paulo tsu ngɛ Kristo Yesu, kɛ nyɛ hu nyɛ he.
Se mɛɛ lɛɛ a li kaa Tsɛ ɔ he munyu Yesu kɛ mɛ ngɛ tue ɔ.
Asafoatsɛngua a bi lɛ ke, “O tuɔ Hela gbi lo?
Lɛ ji yi kɛ ha asafo ɔ nɛ ji lɛ nitsɛ e nɔmlɔ tso ɔ. E mi asafo ɔ puɛ kɛ je. Lɛ ji kekleekle nɔ nɛ a tle si kɛ je gbeje, konɛ e ye kekleekle blɔ he ngɛ níhi tsuo a mi.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Yesu te si, nɛ e nga kɔɔhiɔ kɛ wo nɛ gli ɔ yi. Kɔɔhiɔ ɔ kpa fiami, nɛ wo ɔ ngmɛ dii, nɛ lejɛ ɔ jɔ.
Waa ngɔ lɛ kaa nɔ ko nɛ e he nile deɔ lɛ ke e sɛ kaa a yeɔ ní ngɛ amaga jami he ɔ na mo “ní lelɔ” nɛ o ngɛ ní yee ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Anɛ enɛ ɔ be lɛ he wami woe nɛ lɛ hu e ya ye ní nɛ a kɛ ha amagahi lo?
Jokuɛ ɔ ba wa ngɛ nɔmlɔ tso, kɛ mumi mi tsuo, nɛ e hi nga a nɔ kɛ ya su ligbi nɛ e je e he kpo ngɔ tsɔɔ Israel.
Yesu he nɔ ke, “Mumi yayami be ye mi. Imi lɛɛ Tsaatsɛ hɛ mi nyami i woɔ, se nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ ngɛ ye he guɛ gbee.
Jehanɛ ɔ, munyu nɛ ɔmɛ a he je ɔ, Yesu se nyɛɛli ɔmɛ a ti nihi babauu kpale a se, nɛ a kɛ lɛ nyɛɛ we hu.
Gbenɔ kɛɛ ɔ ji yayami, nɛ yayami he wami ɔ ji mlaa a.
Mo yo nɛ o le Kristo, kɛ o maa pee kɛ le kaa alini mo lɛ o ma he o huno ɔ yi wami? Mo nyumu nɛ o le Kristo, kɛ o maa pee kɛ le kaa alini mo lɛ o ma he o yo ɔ yi wami?
A ngma hulɔ ke, ‘A maa hɛɛ mo dɔdɔɔdɔ ngɛ a dɛ mi, konɛ o nane ko tɛ nɔ́.’ ”
ejakaa i kɛ mo ngɛ. Nɔ ko nɔ ko be nyɛe maa pee mo yayami ko; ejakaa i ngɛ we bi babauu ngɛ ma nɛ ɔ mi.”
Se Barnaba ngɔ lɛ kɛ ya bɔfo ɔmɛ a ngɔ, nɛ e ya sɛɛ nɔ́ nɛ ba a ha mɛ. E de mɛ bɔ nɛ Saulo na Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ngɛ Damasko blɔ ɔ nɔ nɛ e kɛ lɛ tu munyu, kɛ bɔ nɛ pee nɛ e na he wami ngɛ Yesu biɛ mi.
Ní tsumi nɛ ni kpahi tsu ɔ, wa fĩɛ ngɛ he. Niinɛ, wa heɔ yeɔ kaa nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ mi ma ba wa, nɛ wa ma tsu ní nguahi ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti pe bɔ nɛ wa ko nyɛ.
“I kpa we pɛɛ ha je ɔ; mohu ni nɛmɛ nɛ o ha mi ɔ, mɛ i ngɛ pɛɛ kpae ha; ejakaa o nihi ji mɛ.
Wa wó lɛ kɛ je Troya tɛɛ kɛ ya Samotrake, nɛ e nɔ jena a, wa ya su Neapoli.
Nimli kpekpemi ɔ a nya kpɛ a he, nɛ a bi ke, “David Bi ɔ ji nɛ ɔ?”
Yo lɛɛ e yi bwɔmi fuu ɔ ji e hɛ mi nyami. Mawu ha yo yi bwɔmi nɛ e kɛ ha e he.
Se loloolo ɔ, Yuda ma nimeli ɔmɛ he we yi kaa be ko nɛ be ɔ nyumu ɔ hyɛ we nɔ́. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a tsɛ e fɔli ɔmɛ,
Amlɔ nɛ ɔ nɛ nyɛ na le anɔkuale ɔ, ke nyɛ tsu e nya ní ɔ, a gbaa nyɛ!
nɛ e de kɛ ngmlaa ke, “Mawu gbaa mo kulaa pe bɔ nɛ e gbaa yihi tsuo! Bi nɛ ngɛ o mi mi ɔ hu e gbaa lɛ!
Enɛ ɔ he nɛ Yuda bi ɔmɛ ba nu mi ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ, nɛ a ka kaa a maa gbe mi ɔ nɛ.
Benɛ a ba a, e de mɛ ke, “Nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ le bɔ nɛ i kɛ nyɛ hi si be nɛ be ɔ tsuo, kɛ je kekleekle ligbi nɛ i ba Asia a.
Yesu je kpo ngɛ lɛ ɔ mi, nɛ benɛ e na ni ɔmɛ ɔ, e mi mi sã lɛ ngɛ a he, nɛ e tsa a kpɛti hiɔtsɛmɛ ɔmɛ.
Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ wa ha matsɛ ɔ, se kitahi nɛ e ka, kɛ nibwɔhi nɛ pueɔ si ngɛ e hɛ mi ɔ a he je ɔ, e fa ke a pee jokuɛ yo ɔ suɔmi nya ní ɔ ha lɛ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ a ti nɔ kake ja osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa a nyɔguɛ klaate, nɛ e po e hiɔ nɔ tue.
Wɔ nɛ wa he ye ɔ, wɔɔ lɛɛ wa ma ya jɔɔ wa he kaa bɔ nɛ Mawu wo si ɔ. Mawu de ke,
Kɛkɛ nɛ a de ke, “Odase yeli kpahi a he hia we wɔ hu! Wɔ nitsɛmɛ wa nu kɛ je e nya!”
Mlaa nɛ nyɛɛ se ɔ hu ngɛ kaa jã kɛ̃: ‘Suɔ o nyɛmi nɔmlɔ kaa bɔ nɛ o suɔ mo nitsɛ o he.’
Enɛ ɔ he i ngɛ lɛ nyɛ ngɔ tsɔe, konɛ nyɛɛ nu wa he, bɔ nɛ wa ngɛ ha, konɛ nyɛ hu e ba wo nyɛ bua.
Mateo kɛ Toma, Alfeo bi Yakobo, kɛ Simon, (nɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ ma he doolɔ ɔ);
Se ke e na je gba kɛ̃ ɔ, e hi si jã, nɛ e ko gba, aloo e ya nɛ e kɛ e huno ɔ ya dla. Jehanɛ hu, nyumu ko ngmɛɛ e yo he.
Matatia bi ɔ, Amos bi ɔ, Nahum bi ɔ, Esli bi ɔ, Nagai bi ɔ,
nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Tee si! Ngɔɔ bimwɔyo ɔ, kɛ e nyɛ ɔ, nɛ o kpale o se kɛ ya Israel zugba a nɔ. Ejakaa nihi nɛ hla kaa a gbe bimwɔyo ɔ, a gbo.”
Benɛ a tsa hiɔtsɛ nɛ ɔ se ɔ, hiɔtsɛmɛ kpahi nɛ ngɛ zugba nɛ wo bɔle lɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ hu ba, nɛ Paulo tsa mɛ.
Barnaba hɛ ngɛ nɔ kaa a maa ngɔ Yohane nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Marko hulɔ ɔ ngɔ piɛ a he.
Benɛ Petro na lɛ ɔ, e bi Yesu ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, nɔ nɛ ɔ lɛɛ nɛɛ?”
Ejakaa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nitsɛ ma kple si kɛ je hiɔwe kɛ ba kɛ ose nɛ nya wa. Bɔfo nɔkɔtɔma a maa wo gbi, nɛ Mawu titimati ɔ maa pɛ. Nihi nɛ he Yesu ye loko a gbo ɔ maa te si kekle.
Jehanɛ ɔ, imi nyɛ Nyɔmtsɛ, kɛ nyɛ Tsɔɔlɔ ɔ, ke i fɔ nyɛ nane he ɔ, e sa kaa nyɛ hu nyɛ fɔ nyɛ sibi a nane he.
Yuda bi ɔmɛ a ti nihi babauu kane nɔ nɛ a ngma a, ejakaa he nɛ a sɛu Yesu ngɛ ɔ kɛ ma a mi kɛ we; nɛ a ngma nɔ́ ɔ ngɛ Hebri, kɛ Roma, kɛ Hela gbi mi.
Nɛ i na Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nɛ ngɛ mi dee ke, ‘Pee esɔ nɛ o je Yeruslem mlamlaamla, ejakaa nihi nɛ ngɛ hiɛ ɔ, ye he odase nɛ o ngɛ yee ɔ, a be tue bue.’
Kaseli ɔmɛ bi lɛ ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, jije?”
Se ke o ngɛ Mawu nɔ́ ko he pɛɛ kpae ɔ, he ye, nɛ o ko je nɔ́ kulaa kaa Mawu ma ha mo nɔ́ nɛ o ngɛ bie ɔ. Nɔ nɛ jeɔ nɔ́ ɔ, e ngɛ kaa wo mi oslɔke nɛ kɔɔhiɔ ngɛ lɛ fiae kɛ ngɛ yae kɛ ngɛ bae.
Yesu de mɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ hyɛ saminya! Nyɛ hɛ nɛ hi nyɛ he nɔ ngɛ Farisi bi ɔmɛ, kɛ Saduki bi ɔmɛ a masa a he!”

Se ke nɔ ko de nyɛ ke, “Niye ní nɛ ɔ, a kɛ sã bɔ ha amaga” a, lɔ ɔ lɛɛ nyɛ ko ye. Pi nyɛ nitsɛmɛ, loo nyɛ he nile he je nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ enɛ ɔ dee, se nɔ kpa a nɛ de nyɛ lo ɔ he sane ɔ, lɛ mohu e he nile he je.
Imi hu jinɛ i li lɛ, se Mawu, nɔ nɛ tsɔ mi ke ma ba sɔle nihi ngɛ nyu mi ɔ lɛ de mi ke, ‘Nɔ nɛ nɔ nɛ Mumi ɔ ma ba ma a, lɛ ji nɔ nɛ maa ngɔ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ kɛ sɔle nihi.’
Mɛni kake peemi ngɛ Mawu sɔlemi we ɔ kɛ amagahi a kpɛti? Ejakaa wɔɔ lɛɛ Mawu hɛ kalɔ ɔ sɔlemi we ji wɔ! Mawu de ke,
Mohu ta buli ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake kɛ e we akplɔ ɔ gbɔ Yesu kasa mi; nɛ amlɔ ɔ, muɔ kɛ nyu je mi kɛ be.
Yuda kplɛɛ, nɛ e bɔni blɔ hlami, konɛ e ngɔ Yesu ngɔ wo a dɛ mi zaa nɛ ma a kó nu he.
Se wa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ dloomi babauu ɔ nya a, suɔmi, kɛ hemi kɛ yemi nɛ Mawu haa nihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ Kristo Yesu mi ɔ, imi hu i ná.
Yesu he nɔ ke, “Imi ji blɔ ɔ, imi ji anɔkuale ɔ, nɛ imi ji wami ɔ hulɔ. Nɔ ko nɔ ko yɛ Tsɛ ɔ ngɔ kaa ja e gu ye nɔ.
Yesu tsɔ ni nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ nɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ e fa mɛ ke, “Nyɛ ko ya ma je li a zugba ko nɔ, nɛ nyɛ ko sɛ Samaria ma ko mi hulɔ.
Ligbi ko piani ngmlɛ etɛ sɔlemi be ɔ, Petro kɛ Yohane nyɛɛ kɛ yaa sɔlemi we ɔ.
Yesu he nɔ ke, “Nyɛɛ lɛɛ je nɛ ɔ mi bi ji nyɛ; se imi lɛɛ hiɔwe i je. Je nɛ ɔ mi bi ji nyɛ, se imi lɛɛ i ji je nɛ ɔ mi.
Ní nɛ ɔmɛ daa si ngɛ ní pɔtɛɛ komɛ a nane mi. Yi enyɔ ɔmɛ daa si ha somi enyɔ. A kpɛti nɔ kake ji Hagar. E je Sinai yo ɔ nɔ; nɛ bimɛ nɛ e fɔ ɔ, nyɔguɛhi ji mɛ.
Ke nɔ́ nɛ hi si be kpiti kɛkɛ ɔ hɛ mi nyami je kpo ɔ, lɛɛ nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ daa a hɛ mi nyami ɔ pe lɔ ɔ hluu.
I le kaa Abraham nina ji nyɛ! Mɛni he je mɔ nɛ nyɛ ngɔɛ ye tsɔɔmi ɔ, nɛ nyɛ ngɛ mi hlae nyɛɛ gbe mohu ɔ.
Yesu he nɔ ke, “Nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ tsɔɔe ɔ ji imi nitsɛ ye yi mi; nɔ nɛ tsɔ mi ɔ nɛ ngɔ ha mi.
Ejakaa nɔ nɛ nɛ́ mɔbɔ ɔ, benɛ a maa kojo lɛ ɔ, Mawu be lɛ mɔbɔ nae; se ke o naa mɔbɔ ɔ, Mawu be mo fɔ bue.
Ejakaa mlaa nɛ wa wo nyɛ ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu biɛ mi ɔ, nyɛ le.
Ke nyɛ kane womi nɛ ɔ gbe nya a, nyɛ ha nɛ a kane ngɔ ha Laodikea asafo ɔ hulɔ. Womi nɛ i sɛ hlami ngma mane Laodikea asafo ɔ, nyɛ hu nyɛɛ kane.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, wa nyɛmimɛ, nyɛɛ hla nyɛ kpɛti ni kpaago, nihi nɛ ngɛ biɛ kpakpa; nihi nɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ hyi mɛ tɔ, nɛ a le ní hulɔ, konɛ waa ngɔ mɛ ngɔ to ní tsumi nɛ ɔ nya.
Yesu he nɔ ke, “Kaa imi nitsɛ nɛ i woɔ ye hɛ mi nyami ɔ, lɛɛ lɔ ɔ pi nɔ́ ko; se hyɛ, Tsaatsɛ nɛ nyɛ tsɛɔ ke nyɛ Mawu ɔ, lɛ nɔuu nɛ woɔ ye hɛ mi nyami.
E fa nihi nɛ ngɛ Paulo nya poe ɔ ke a ba mo nitsɛ o ngɔ. Ke o ta e nya mi ɔ, mo nitsɛ o maa nu níhi tsuo nɛ waa kɛ ngɛ e nya poe ɔ.”
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ hyɛ nɛ hi, konɛ nɔ́ nɛ gbali ɔmɛ de ɔ kó ba nyɛ nɔ. A ke,
Se ke o ná ngɔ yo ɔ, o pee we yayami. Jã kɛ̃ ke yo nɛ gba we lolo hu gba a, e pee we yayami. Se dengme nɛ ngɛ gba si himi mi he je ɔ, i na nɛ nyɛ je nyɛ hɛ ngɔ fɔ si mohu amlɔ nɛ ɔ.
Yesu he nɔ ke, “Nyɛ li mi, nɛ Tsaatsɛ hu nyɛ li lɛ. Kaa nyɛ le mi jinɛ nyɛ maa le Tsaatsɛ hulɔ.”
Kplu ko maa si ngɛ lejɛ ɔ kɛ e mi dã tɔtɔɔtɔ nɛ kuã. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a ngɔ wo mi kutsa ngɔ sɔ dã a mi, nɛ a ngɔ ma tso nya, nɛ a kɛ to e nya he.
Daa otsi mi kekleekle ligbi ɔ, sika nɛ nyɛ ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ naa ngɛ otsi ɔ mi ɔ, e je eko ngɔ to, nɛ e hi nya buae. Kɛkɛ ɔ, ke i ba a, e be hiae kaa a tsu sika hu.
Osatotsɛmɛ! Nɔ́ nɛ Yesaya gba ngɛ nyɛ he ɔ, anɔkuale sisiisi! Yesaya ngma ke,
Filipo ya je Azoto. E fiɛ sane kpakpa a ngɛ ma amɛ tsuo a mi hluu kɛ ya su Kaisarea.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Yesu kaseli ɔmɛ ba e ngɔ, nɛ a ba bi lɛ ke, “Mɛni he je o kɛ ni ɔmɛ ngɛ munyu tue ngɛ abɛ gbi mi ɔ?”
Ejakaa sɛ gbi nɛ kɔɔ Mawu Bi, Yesu Kristo ɔ he nɛ i kɛ Silvano kɛ Timoteo fiɛ ngɔ ha nyɛ ɔ tsakee we kɛ je “Ee” ba pee “Dɛbi” be kake too. Mohu ɔ, lɛ ji “Ee” Mawu ɔ nɛ.
Se nyɛ le nɔ́ nɛ tsi e nya nɛ e ba je we e he kpo lolo ɔ? Ke be ɔ su ɔ, dikalɔ ɔ ma ba hia kpo kɛ̃.
kaa nihi nɛ a nyɔmtsɛ ho yo kpeemi ya, nɛ a ngɛ lɛ blɔ hyɛe. Ke a pee klaalo ɔ, ke e kpale kɛ ba nɛ e ba si sinya pɛ kɛkɛ a bli ha lɛ amlɔ.
Nyumu ko ngɛ ma a mi, nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Zakeo. Tó tsulɔ nɔkɔtɔma ji lɛ, nɛ e ngɛ ní.
Se Yesu nu, nɛ e de Yairo ke, “Koo ye gbeye; moo lɛɛ he ye kɛkɛ, nɛ e yi ma na wami ekohu.”
Ejakaa Mose mlaa a nyɛ we nɛ e pee nɔ́ ko nɛ hi kɛ pi si. Se nɔ́ nɛ wa ngɔ wa hɛ kɛ fɔ nɔ jehanɛ ɔ hi saminya; nɛ wa nyɛɔ wa hɛɛ kɛ suu Mawu he.
Se nɔ nɛ be ní nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, lɛɛ e ngɛ kaa nɔ nɛ hyɛ we nɔ́ kɛ yɛ tsitsaa; e hɛ je nɔ kaa a tsukɔ e he kɛ je e sá yayami ɔmɛ a he.
E nɔ jena a, e kɛ mɛ pue nɔ kɛ ho; nɛ nyɛmimɛ nɛ ngɛ Yopa a a ti ni komɛ piɛ e he.
Benɛ i ngɛ Damasko ɔ, amlaalo ɔ nɛ ngɛ Matsɛ Areta sisi ɔ ha a huɔ ngɛ Damasko ma a mi, konɛ a nu mi.
Maat bi ɔ, Matatia bi ɔ, Semein bi ɔ, Yosek bi ɔ, Yoda bi ɔ.
Ejakaa nɔ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ suɔ ɔ lɛ e tsɔseɔ, nɛ e fiaa nɔ
Yesu de lɛ ke, “Ha nɛ ni gbogboehi nɛ a pu mɛ nitsɛmɛ a ni gbogboehi. Se moo lɛɛ yaa nɛ o ya fiɛ Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ he sane ɔ.”
E Bi ɔ ha nɛ wa ye wa he; ee, e kɛ wa he yayami pa wɔ.
Ni komɛ hu ngɛ dee ke Eliya lɛ ba; nɛ ni komɛ hu ke blema gbali ɔmɛ eko lɛ kpale ba wami mi ekohu.
Pi níhi nɛ a naa ngɛ adesa wami si himi mi daa ligbi kɛkɛ a he munyu nɛ i ngɛ tue. Nyɛ maa na nɔ́ nɛ i de nɛ ɔ nɔuu ngɛ Mawu mlaa womi ɔ mi.
A ba ye suɔmi nɛ o ngɛ kɛ ha mɛ ɔ he odase ha asafo ɔ ngɛ hiɛ ɔ. I kpa mo pɛɛ nɛ o wo mɛ blɔ saminya bɔ nɛ maa sa Mawu hɛ mi nɛ a kɛ tsa a blɔ hiami ɔ nɔ.
E maa te si ngɔ wo nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ a tsɛɛ mawu, loo nɔ́ ko nɛ a jaa a, nɛ e ma wo e he nɔ ngɛ mɛ tsuo a nɔ. E ma ya hi Mawu sɔlemi we ɔ mi tete po, nɛ e ma de ke lɛ ji Mawu.
Yesu de mɛ ke, “Mawu ji nyɛ Tsɛ niinɛ jinɛ nyɛ maa suɔ mi, ejakaa Mawu nɛ tsɔ mi; se pi imi nitsɛ ye yi mi nɛ i to kɛ ba. Mawu ngɔ nɛ i je kɛ ba nyɛ ngɔ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ yo ɔ ba kpla si ngɛ Yesu nane nya, nɛ e de ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, naa mi mɔbɔ!”
Ejakaa ke nɔ ko ngɛ je mi ɔ, gbosi ní yemi blɔ nya tomi womi nɛ e pee ɔ, a kɛ tsu we ní; ja e gbo.
Hagar ngɛ kaa Sinai yo ɔ nɛ ngɛ Arabia a. Lɔ ɔ ji Yerusalem ma nɛ ngɛ amlɔ nɛ ɔ, ejakaa e kɛ e mi bi ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ nyɔguɛ yemi mi kɛ mwɔɔ.
Nɔ nɛ dla e he saminya a, nyɛ he lɛ atuu kɛ bu, nɛ nyɛ de lɛ ke, “I kpa mo pɛɛ, ba hi hiɛ!” Se ohiatsɛ ɔ lɛɛ, nyɛ de lɛ ke, “Dá si ngɛ lejɛ ɔ he ko!” aloo “Ba sɔ̃ si ngɛ hiɛ ɔ!”
Festo ye maa pee ligbi kpaanyɔ, loo nyɔngma ngɛ a ngɔ, kɛkɛ nɛ e pue nɔ kɛ ho Kaisarea ya. E nɔ jena a, e ya hi kojomi sɛ ɔ nɔ, nɛ e fa ke a kɛ Paulo nɛ ba.
Munyu ɔ ba plɛ adesa, nɛ e kɛ wɔ hi si. Dloomi kɛ anɔkuale hyi lɛ babauu. Wa na lɛ, nɛ a wo e hɛ mi nyami kaa lɛ pɛ ji Tsɛ ɔ Bi.
Tsɛ ɔ ha Bi ɔ he blɔ kaa e kojo nihi, ejakaa lɛ ji Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ nɛ.
Jehanɛ ɔ, Yesu kpale de mɛ ekohu ke, “Nyɛ he manye! Bɔ nɛ Tsɛ ɔ tsɔ mi ɔ, ja nɔuu imi hu i ngɛ nyɛ tsɔe.”
Sɛ gbi nɛ Mawu bɔfo ɔmɛ kɛ ba a ngɛ mi sisiisi; nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ gbo tue, loo e bui ɔ, a gbla e tue bɔ nɛ sa lɛ.
E de mɛ ke, “I kɛ he hiami hyɛ blɔ wawɛɛ kaa i kɛ nyɛ maa ye Hetsɔmi niye ní nɛ ɔ loko ma na amanehlu!
Benɛ Yesu de enɛ ɔ, tsɔli ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ a ti nɔ kake gba lɛ ma, nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Heto nɛ o ha osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa a ji nɛ ɔ?”
Nyɛ ko de dã, ejakaa e kɛ sakasaka peemi lɛ nyɛɛɔ. Mohu ɔ, nyɛ ha nɛ mumi ɔ nɛ hyi nyɛ.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ngɔɛ lɛ nitsɛ e sɛumi tso ngɔ fɔɛ e konɔ kɛ ba nyɛɛ ye se ɔ, e be nyɛe maa pee ye kaselɔ.
A ma sake mɛ ngɔ fɔ flɔɔnɔɔ kɛ e mi la hɛuu ɔ mi; nɛ lejɛ ɔ, a maa wo yana, nɛ a ma kpe lungu nya.”
Saulo tsɔ fia si, nɛ e nu gbi ko nɛ ngɛ lɛ bie ke, “Saulo, Saulo, mɛni he je o ngɛ mi yi mi wae?”
Nihi a nya kɛkɛ a nuɔ ngɛ ke, “Nyumu ɔ nɛ wa wɔ yi mi sa a, hemi kɛ yemi ɔ nɛ e ka kaa e ma kpata hɛ mi ɔ, jehanɛ lɛɛ jamɛ a hemi kɛ yemi ɔ e ngɛ fiɛe.”
Abraham fɔ Isak, nɛ Isak fɔ Yakob, nɛ Yakob fɔ Yuda kɛ e nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ.
Abolokplolo nyami be ɔ se ɔ, wa wó lɛ kɛ je Filipi, nɛ ligbi enuɔ se ɔ, wa ya na mɛ ngɛ Troya, nɛ waa kɛ mɛ hi lejɛ ɔ otsi.
Se jehanɛ ɔ lɛɛ nyɛ kpa ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo: mi mi la, mimi fumi, kɛ yi wu tso ní peemi. Nyɛ ko gbe nɔ he guɛ, nɛ munyu yaya ko kó je nyɛ nya.
E fiɛɛ Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ he sane, nɛ e tsɔɔ mɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo he sane. E tu munyu kɛ kã nɛ gbeye yemi ko be e mi; nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko hu tsi we lɛ blɔ.
A he nɔ ke, “Ngɛ Betlehem nɛ ngɛ Yudea a. Ejakaa bɔ nɛ gbalɔ ɔ ngma ji nɛ ɔ nɛ:
Benɛ a bɔ amaniɛ ɔ ta a, Yakobo wo e nya nɔ nɛ e de ke, “Nyɛmimɛ, nyɛɛ bu mi tue!
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a maa je o sɔlemi we ɔ he, nɛ e maa fɔ si gu.
“Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, ke nɔ ko de nyɛ ke, ‘Hyɛ, Kristo ɔ ngɛ hiɛ ɔ’, aloo, ‘E ngɛ lejɛ’ ɔ, nyɛ ko he ye.
Paulo he nɔ ke, “Imi lɛɛ Yuda no ji mi. A fɔ mi ngɛ Tarso, Kilikia ma nɛ ngɛ biɛ saminya a. I kpa mo pɛɛ, ha nɛ i kɛ ma a nɛ tu munyu bɔɔ.”
Nihi nɛ ya je Paulo blɔ ɔ kɛ lɛ ya su Atene tɔɔ loko a kpale kɛ ba Beroya. Paulo kɛ sɛ mane ke Sila kɛ Timoteo nɛ ba ná lɛ be kpiti mi.
Hemi kɛ yemi lɛ ha nɛ nimli nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ mahi hwu ta, nɛ a ye kunimi; a ha nɛ jatahi ma a nya.
Sa a, nyɛ ngɛ kaa ni komɛ nɛ gbo, ejakaa nyɛ peeɔ yayami, nɛ he lo nya a, a pui nyɛ. Se amlɔ nɛ ɔ, Mawu ha nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ Kristo tsuo ba wami mi ekohu; ee, Mawu ngɔ wɔ tsuo wa he yayami ɔmɛ ngɔ pa wɔ.
nyɛ je ni komɛ hu kɛ je la a mi; nyɛɛ na ni kpa komɛ hu mɔbɔ nɛ gbeye yemi ngɛ mi. Se tadehi nɛ a wo ɔ tete po nyɛɛ hie; ejakaa a kɛ he lo akɔnɔ wo he mu.
Nɛ ye he ɔ, a wo Mawu hɛ mi nyami.
Mawu ngɔ lɛ nitsɛ e mumi ɔ ngɔ ha wɔ. Nɛ enɛ ɔ waa kɛ na kaa niinɛ, Mawu ngɛ wa mi; nɛ wɔ hu wa ngɛ e mi.
Kpe nguaa a mi bi ɔmɛ tsuo te si, nɛ a hɛɛ Yesu mi kɛ ya Pilato ngɔ.
“Bi nɔkɔtɔma a mi mi fu wawɛɛ, nɛ e kua we ɔ mi sɛmi. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e tsɛ ɔ je kpo nɛ e ba de lɛ ke, ‘Ye bi, i kpa mo pɛɛ, moo ba kɛkɛ.’
A wui Melkizedek tsɛ, loo e nyɛ ta; e weku kpa ko be ɔ, be nɛ a fɔ lɛ, kɛ be nɛ e gbo hu nɔ ko li. E ngɛ kaa Mawu Bi ɔ, nɛ e ngɛ osɔfo yee kɛ yaa neneene.
Jehanɛ hu, nɔmlɔ ɔ nɛ a de ní nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ e he ɔ, wɛtso kpa kulaa mi no ji lɛ; nɛ nɔ ko ji jamɛ a wɛtso ɔ mi nɛ e ba sɔmɔ ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he gblee.
Be tsuaa be ɔ, wa ngɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ a he nyae ngɛ he tsuaa he; enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, wa naa mo si.
Enɛ ɔmɛ nɛ ni komɛ susu kaa a nine su nɔ ɔ ha nɛ a hemi kɛ yemi ɔ bɔ mɛ.
I kɛ nyɛ ngɛ munyu tue kaa a kɛ juɛmitsɛmɛ tuɔ munyu; nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ dee ɔ, nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ kɔ se.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Levi te si, nɛ e si e nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́, nɛ e nyɛɛ Yesu se.
Benɛ a fia mɛ kpa gbegbelii se ɔ, a wo mɛ tsu, nɛ a fa pamitsɛmɛ a nɔ hyɛlɔ ɔ ke e ngmɛ a yi saminya.
Ke nɔ ko ba ye nyɛ nyɔguɛ, loo adufude, loo e ba pee nyɛ kuasia, loo e ba wo e he nɔ ngɛ nyɛ nɔ, loo e ba gba nyɛ hɛ mi ma po, nyɛ de we nɔ́ ko.
Benɛ e kaseli Yakobo, kɛ Yohane nu he ɔ, a bi lɛ ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, o suɔ kaa wa de nɛ la nɛ je hiɔwe ba sã mɛ
Kɛkɛ nɛ nyumu ko kpa ngmlaa kɛ je ni ɔmɛ a kpɛti, nɛ e de ke, “Tsɔɔlɔ! I kpa mo pɛɛ, hyɛ ye binyumu ɔ, ye bi kake too ɔ!
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ kua mi, nɛ e ngɔɛ munyu nɛ i fiɛ ɔ hulɔ ɔ, nɔ ko ngɛ nɛ maa kojo lɛ. Nyagbe ligbi ɔ, munyu ɔmɛ nɛ i tu ɔ maa kojo lɛ.
Yihewi ɔmɛ tsuo te si, nɛ a tsɛ̃ a kane ɔmɛ a mi.
Nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ kua nɔ klɔuklɔu ɔ nɛ dami sane pɛ e yeɔ ɔ, nɛ nyɛ kpa pɛɛ ke a ngmɛɛ awi yelɔ mohu he ngɔ ha nyɛ.
Mawu tsɛ we wɔ nɛ wa ba tsu mu ní, se mohu bɔ nɛ pee nɛ wa he nɛ tsɔ.
Be ko ɔ, Yohane de Herode ke, “E dɛ kaa o ngɔɔ Herodia!”

Se imi lɛɛ i be fĩae ngɔ fɔ nɔ́ kpa ko nɔ́ kpa ko nɔ kaa ja wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo sɛumi tso ɔ pɛ. Gbenɔ nɛ Kristo gbo ngɛ sɛumi tso ɔ nɔ ɔ ngɛ kaa nɔ́ nɛ pe a sɛu je ɔ kɛ ha mi, nɛ a sɛu imi hu kɛ ha je ɔ.
Se Petro kplɛɛ we. E de lɛ ke, “Awenyɛ, i li lɛ!”

Se Mawu piɛ ye he kɛ ba su mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ, nɛ i daa si ngɛ nyɛ hɛ mi kɛ ngɛ odase yee kɛ ngɛ nimli tsuo tsɔɔe, nimli wawi kɛ nimli nguahi tsuo. Nɔ́ nɛ Mose kɛ gbali ɔmɛ de to kaa e maa ba mi ɔ, lɔ ɔ nɔuu nɛ i ngɛ dee.
Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Yesu kɛ nimli kpekpemi ɔ, kɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ tu munyu. E de mɛ ke,

I kpa nyɛ pɛɛ, ke i ba nyɛ ngɔ ɔ, nyɛ ko ha nɛ ma pee nɔ́ ko nɛ maa tsɔɔ kaa i ngɛ nyɛ nɔ yee tsɔ. Nihi nɛ ngɛ ye he munyu tue ke i ngɛ ní tsue kaa je mi no ɔ, i le kaa ma nyɛ nɛ i kɛ mɛ maa to ní saminya.
Gbɔkuɛ, benɛ Yesu kɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ ba bua kɛ ngɛ ní yee ɔ, jamɛ a be ɔ, Abosiami wo Simon Iskariot bi Yuda yi mi momo kaa e tsɔɔ Yesu se blɔ.
Kristo gbo nɛ e kɛ po Yuda bi a mlaa a, kɛ a kɔ ɔmɛ a mi, nɛ e pee Yuda bi ɔmɛ, kɛ ma je li ɔmɛ kake ngɛ lɛ nitsɛ e mi; nɛ enɛ ɔ kɛ he jɔmi ba.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nihi tsuo nɛ maa gu e nɔ kɛ ba Mawu ngɔ, amlɔ nɛ ɔ jio, hwɔɔ se jio, e ma he a yi wami. Ejakaa e ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene, nɛ e ngɛ Mawu pɛɛ kpae ha mɛ.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, ma kpa Tsɛ ɔ pɛɛ, nɛ e ma ha nyɛ Hepiɛlɔ kpa nɛ kɛ nyɛ maa hi si daa.
Yesu he nɔ ke, “Nyakpɛ nɔ́ kake pɛ i pee nɛ nyɛ tsuo nyɛ hɛ mi pee nyɛ yaa.
Benɛ ní yemi be ɔ su ɔ, e tsɔ nɔ ke e ya de nihi nɛ a kpee ɔ ke, ‘A gbe nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nya; nyɛɛ ba!’
A de a he ke, “Benɛ wa ngɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ kɛ ma nɛ e ngɛ wɔ ngmami ɔmɛ a sisi tsɔɔe ɔ, hyɛ bɔ nɛ wa nɔ gbagba te ha!”
Maria susu kaa eko ɔ, abɔɔ ɔ mi dlalɔ ji lɛ, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e de Yesu ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, ke mo nɛ o ba wo lɛ kɛ je hiɛ ɔ, lɛɛ tsɔɔ mi he nɛ o kɛ lɛ ya fɔ nɛ ma ya wo lɛ.”
Ní leli ɔmɛ lɛɛ a hɛɛ nu kɛ tɔ ngɔ piɛ a kane ɔmɛ a he.
Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Yesu kɛ ni ɔmɛ tu munyu ngɛ abɛ gbi mi ke, “Nyumu niatsɛ ko zugba ba ní babauu.
kɛ yi komɛ hu nɛ e hia mumi yayamihi ngɛ a mi, nɛ e tsa a hiɔhi ha mɛ. Mɛ ji Maria (nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Magdalena), nɔ nɛ a hia mumi yayami kpaago ngɛ e mi ɔ,
Nyɛ kai kaa i de nyɛ momo ke, ‘Nyɔguɛ pã we e nyɔmtsɛ.’ Nɛ́ a wa mi yi mi ɔ, nyɛɛ lɛɛ kɛ a maa pee nyɛ kɛɛ? Ke a bu mi tue ɔ, nyɛ hu a maa bu nyɛ tue.
nɛ e ka kita kɛ wo lɛ si ke, “Bi mi nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ o suɔ, nɛ ma ha mo!”
Ligbi ko ɔ, nyumu ko ba Yesu ngɔ ba bi lɛ ke, “Tsɔɔlɔ, mɛni nɔ́ kpakpa po ma pee nɛ ma na neneene wami?”
Wa nɛmɛ ja Mawu ngɛ yo nɛ ɔ nɔ, se nyɛ Yuda bi lɛɛ nyɛ ke Yerusalem ji he nɛ sa kaa wa ja Mawu ngɛ.”
Filipo ya Samaria ma nguaa amɛ eko mi, nɛ e ya fiɛ Kristo he sane ɔ ngɔ tsɔɔ mɛ.
Ke wa de ke yayami ko be wa he ɔ, wɔ nitsɛmɛ wa he wa ngɛ sisie; nɛ Mawu we anɔkuale ɔ be wa mi.
Nyɔguɛhi, nyɛɛ bu nyɛ je nɛ ɔ mi nyɔmtsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ mi, pi kɛ hɛ mi sɔmɔmi nɛ ma ha nyɛ nyɔmtsɛmɛ ɔmɛ maa suɔ nyɛ sane. Mohu ɔ, nyɛɛ bu mɛ kɛ je nyɛ tsui mi kaa nihi nɛ yeɔ Mawu gbeye.
Bɔ nɛ o tsɔ mi je ɔ mi ɔ, ja nɔuu imi hu i ngɛ mɛ tsɔe.
Yesu kɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ kuɔ yo ɔ, nɛ a ya hi si.
A mi mi fu wawɛɛ, ejakaa bɔfo enyɔ ɔmɛ ngɛ ma a ní tsɔɔe ke Yesu te si kɛ je gbeje, nɛ lɔ ɔ maa nɔ mi kaa gbogboehi maa te si kɛ ba wami mi.
Se nyɛ pueɔ ohiatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a hɛ mi si. Anɛ pi niatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ nɛ waa nyɛ yi mi ɔ? Anɛ pi mɛ nɛ a ngɔɔ nyɛ kɛ yaa kojomi he ɔ?
Jehanɛ, e kukuɔ abolo kpaago ɔ, kɛ lo ɔ, nɛ e na Mawu si, nɛ e ku mi, nɛ e ngɔ ha e kaseli ɔmɛ. Nɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ hu dla ngɔ ha ma a.
Apaa yeli nɛ hu nyɛ ngmɔ ɔmɛ ha nyɛ ɔ, nyɛ wui mɛ hiɔ. Nyɛɛ hyɛ bɔ nɛ a ngɛ ngmlaa kpae boboobo ha! Ní kpali nɛ bua nyɛ ngmɔ ní nya a a ngmlaa a ya su Nyɔmtsɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ tue mi tɔɔ.
Si kake too ɔ, hiɔwe bɔfohi a ta nguaa ba piɛ bɔfo ɔ he, nɛ a la kɛ je Mawu yi ke,
Sa a, nyɛ puɛ be babauu kɛ pee níhi nɛ ma je li suɔ peemi, yahomi, akɔnɔ níhi a se dimi, dã demi, fiɛmi sakasaka, jiklɔɔ peemi, kɛ wɔ jami ní kpɔtɔkpɔtɔ peemi.
